articleTitle: Analysis and application of Wireshark in TCP/IP protocol teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: TCP/IP is widely employed to interconnect computing facilities in today's network environments, and it is the most important content of networking elements study. This paper introduces the functions and characteristics of Wireshark, and expounds its analysis and application in TCP/IP protocol teaching by some specific examples. The practice shows that good teaching result will be received with the aid of Wireshark and it is worth popularization and application.

articleTitle: Primary exploration of mobile learning mode under a cloud computing environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Cloud computing affects the development of mobile learning with its unique advantages. This article first sums up the traditional mode of mobile learning, analyses the characteristics of various patterns, sum up the characteristics of the cloud computing, and then make mobile learning mode under a cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Application of Proteus virtual system modelling (VSM) in teaching of microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Microcontrollers are widely applied in the field of industry to solve engineering control problems. The increased use of microcontrollers makes microcontroller course necessary for electricity related speciality. A new simulation software package for microcontroller, Proteus virtual system modelling (VSM), is introduced for industrial and educational use. Proteus VSM combines circuit simulation, animated components and microprocessor models to facilitate co-simulation of complete microcontroller based designs. Proteus VSM makes it possible to develop and test designs before a physical prototype is constructed. The functions and advantages of Proteus VSM are introduced. The comparisons of Proteus VSM lab against hardware lab are deeply discussed. Proteus VSM is uniquely suited to teaching students about the design and operation of microcontroller-based systems.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization of PID controllers based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: A PID parameter optimization method based on genetic algorithm was presented in this paper. A performance index based on integral of absolute error, rise time, controller output and overshoot was given as an objective function of optimization, and genetic algorithm was applied to optimizing parameters of PID controllers. Simulation results indicate that genetic algorithm is a reasonable and effective method for parameter optimization of PID controllers.

articleTitle: The building of cloud computing environment for e-health
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Aimed to the defects of traditional hospital management system, this paper develops a new intelligent management system based on cloud computing. The characteristics of cloud computing are listed by introducing the definition, framework and basic capabilities. It can closely link the various medical departments and coordinate among medical institutions in the business. With achieving a strong information technology resources and optimizing patient flow, cloud computing improves efficiency in the use of medical resources.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an improved RSA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper aims at speeding up RSA decryption and signature. The performance of RSA decryption and signature has direct relationship with the efficiency of modular exponentiation implementation. This paper proposes a variant of RSA cryptosystem (EAMRSA-Encrypt Assistant Multi- Prime RSA) by reducing modules and private exponents in modular exponentiation. The experimental result shows that the speed of the decryption and signature has been substantially improved and the variant can be efficiently implemented in parallel.

articleTitle: Overview of data dissemination strategy in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Each sensor node has the capacity of data collection, storage and transmission in the wireless sensor networks. They are usually scattered across the entire monitoring region and coordinate with each other to complete the monitoring task. The wireless sensor network can be regarded as a distributed database system. However, sensor nodes have energy and computational constraints. So some traditional distributed data dissemination schemas face new challenges. According to the characteristics of wireless sensor networks, some design and evaluation criterions are proposed in this paper at first. Then, several main data dissemination strategies are described. Meanwhile their excellences and drawbacks are analyzed and evaluated from several aspects such as energy cost, load balance, robustness and stability. Finally, some conclusions and future research trends are pointed out.

articleTitle: Digital signature in the application of e-commerce security
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: How we can ensure the security of data transmitted over the Internet and the identity of each trading party is the key to the development of e-commerce. The key problem of e-commerce is security problems. This paper focuses on digital signature technology in the application of e-commerce security issues, based on the core of a digital signature algorithm, which is a DSA algorithm idea. Combining specific business e-commerce applications, the paper simulates the actual situation, analyzes and solves problems, and put particular emphasis on the research of the algorithm and the improvement of DSA.

articleTitle: Study of the Bayesian networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: A Bayesian network is a graphical model that finds probabilistic relationships among rubles of the system. Bayesian networks pass evidence (data) between nodes and use the expectations from the world model, they can be considered as bi-directional learning systems. In this paper, we provide a detailed definition of Bayesian networks and related theorems. The chain rule theorem is introduced to do the necessary calculations in Bayesian networks. We provide theoretical and historical details on evidential reasoning using the chain rule. Then we explore some questions about the relationship between Bayesian Networks and the functionality of a human brain as our last topic in Bayesian networks. Finally, we introduce influence diagrams method to convert beliefs of an agent into actions.

articleTitle: A novel water pollution monitoring approach based on 3s technique
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The Use of 3S techniques can provide a firm foundation for the dynamic monitoring and forecasting of water pollution and cause effective control of water environment, as it has no limit to space-time and region and can provide a timely, accurate and fast access to water pollution monitoring, so it will be a great revolution in utilization of water resources. The developed forecasting system is designed to predict water pollution variables using remote sensing data.

articleTitle: The shallow analysis of the enlightenment of Cloud Computing to distance education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the rapidly development of Internet, Cloud Computing born to the world. Because of providing network service, the reliable data and the powerful computing, it receives much attention. Along with cloud computing development and consummation, it will definitely promote the distance education. This article from five aspects including sharing resource, the information security, the feasibility of distance education experiment, support service and cooperation study and so on elaborate the influence of cloud computing to distance education.

articleTitle: Design of road tracing navigation control for smart car use CCD sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: A road tracing hardware and navigation algorithm for smart car is designed based on CCD vision. The road image is obtained by CCD, and is been processed within full-line, regional searched and key points selected to calculate the route curve, and the route curve is classify for difference control strategy. Depending on the different curve of route, the corresponding control strategy is selected. An intelligent vehicle tracing algorithm which is based on PD control is designed. Through practice, this algorithm can made the smart car run stably and rapidly, even if the guide line of the road is complex.

articleTitle: Research of physical condition monitoring system for the elderly based on Zigbee wireless network technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This article described the emerging wireless networking technology to analyze its applicability and advantages in monitoring human health in the home environment. This application was carried out by setting up a star-shaped structure of wireless sensor monitoring network, for the characteristics of care for the elderly and monitoring requirements; putting forward the whole structure of physical condition monitoring system for the elderly; and further exploring the structure and function of major nodes and the modules.

articleTitle: Face recognition system to enhance E Health
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Biometrics serves to identify and authenticate individuals and is in many cases replacing current password systems. Its relevance is increasing in many areas of our daily lives, one of them being healthcare. The merits of biometrics to perform e-Health are discussed in this paper. We feel that the optical sensor (fingerprint, finger-vein, face, iris, and retina) using the videophone system is a promising biometrics system for e-Health, e.g. telemedicine. Face recognition is one of the most hot, potential and challengeable technologies, which is based on biometrics. As the most natural and friendly identification method, automatic face recognition has become the important part of the next generation computing technology. Utilize the symmetry of the face for face recognition, select average half-face for research. The consequence of this discovery may result in substantial savings in storage and computation time. We would like to apply the average-half-face to facial feature extraction methods using wavelets and PCA.

articleTitle: Automatic Camshift tracking algorithm based on fuzzy inference background difference combining with twice searching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcoming that traditional Camshift needs artificial orientation during tracking, this paper proposes a new approach of Camshift tracking algorithm based on fuzzy inference background difference. In this paper, the object contour extracted by background difference rather than artificial selection, is used as initial search window so as to realize automatic Camshift tracking. Meanwhile, to avoid object divergence and object losing when the object moves too quickly, twice Camshift searching is combined with background difference to enlarge the search window automatically to ensure consistent targeting. Furthermore, this paper also introduces contour marking and multiple Camshift trackers to implement successful multi-object tracking. Methods mentioned above prove themselves efficient and automatic in tracking one or more moving fishes during the experiments.

articleTitle: Anti-interference performance of multi-path direct sequence spread spectrum wireless communication system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In order to improve information transmission rate in unit bandwidth, using direct-sequence spread-spectrum CDMA thinking, creatively present a new multi-path direct sequence spread spectrum wireless communication systems' model, and give its multi-path interference performance based on MATLAB. Simulation results show that the system can increase the information transmission rate in unit bandwidth through enhancing the length of the spreading code and the SNR.

articleTitle: Digital circuit experiment system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Traditional digital circuit equipments have some deficiencies, such as limited functionality, fixed experiment types, needing complex wire connection operation, only dealing with simple experiment and so on. The paper presents a FPGA-based digital circuit experiment system that provides a rich set of peripheral interfaces and design resources, and on the system function implementation and function verification of various digital circuit designs can be easily realized aided by EDA software. The paper provides experiment operation method and three-stage experiment training method on the system, and it shows the system supports most traditional experiments, but can realizes most of the functions the traditional ones cannot realize, meanwhile gives a flexible and high efficiency design pattern.

articleTitle: An intrusion detection method based on decision tree
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: How to find the intrusion behaviors is a problem that troubled the intrusion detection field for years. Until now, there is not a good method to solve it, epically in a realistic context. Most methods are effective on small data sets, but when used to the massive data of IDS, the effectiveness seems to be unsatisfactory. In this paper, a new method based on decision tree is discussed to solve the problem of low detection rate of massive data.

articleTitle: The research of event-related potentials in working memory of the juvenile internet addiction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Internet addiction disorder, as a form of technological addiction, will cause neurological complications, psychological disturbances, and relational chaos. Teenagers are in the most vulnerable age group, who will develop more serious complications than other age groups when addicted to the Internet. The objective of this study was to analyze the damage in working memory of the juvenile Internet addiction (IAD). The Chinese words Recognition is used as the experimental paradigms of event-related potentials (ERP). 13 normal teenagers and 10 internet addiction received recognition task which use the old/new effects during Chinese words and the behavior data and electroencephalogram signals were recorded by the experiment equipment. After the data disposed, compared with the normal, both the ERP and the behavior data of the IAD have some obvious characteristics. The difference reveals the damage of the working memory from the neurophysiology.

articleTitle: Development and research of multimedia courseware sharing platform based on GAE
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Cloud computing is another new network concept after grid computing and the trends of next generation of Internet. In the field of education, cloud computing is the basic environment and platform of E-learning in the future, which will produce a wide range of effects for information-oriented education. This paper introduces the concept, characteristics and basic principles of cloud computing, and then highlight Google App Engine (GAE) platform. Finally, the article builds a multimedia courseware sharing platform based on GAE to illustrate the application of the cloud computing platform in the information-oriented education.

articleTitle: Reform on experiment teaching of single-chip microcomputer and cultivation of students' practical ability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: According to the recent situation of experiment teaching of single-chip microcomputer, this paper analyzes the necessity of experiment teaching reform. With the purpose of developing the students' practical ability, reform measures are proposed in terms of experimental content, experimental methods, laboratory management and assessment methods. These measures are applied and good effect is obtained.

articleTitle: Comparison of several sensor deployments in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, the number of sensor nodes has direct relation to the cost of total wireless sensor networks, and at the same time, the problem is closely connected to wireless sensor networks' performance, such as robust, fault-tolerance, and furthermore, it is considered at first as wireless sensor networks are designed. Therefore, the research on the number of sensor nodes has significant meanings of theory and practice to design of wireless sensor networks. By computation and analysis, the sensor deployments in the form of equilateral triangle, as a rule, are better than those in the form of square, and the efficient coverage area ratios decrease with increasing number of sensor nodes.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation of enterprise's core competence based on AHP and fuzzy mathematics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Based on AHP and fuzzy mathematics theory, the article attempts to conduct a research on the evaluation of enterprise's core competence from intellectual capital perspective by using multi-level fuzzy mathematics measure model. After introducing core competence theory and the relationship between core competence and intellectual capital, we constructed an evaluation index system on the basis of structure of intellectual capital and also established a fuzzy mathematics measure model. The case analysis presented proves that this model is feasible and simple and the result of appraisal is reasonable and credible.

articleTitle: A new fingerprint image recognition approach using artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this article, the application algorithm in fingerprint image recognition based on artificial neural network and wavelet transform is put forward. In this algorithm, we have constructed a flatten-structure element utilizing the low-frequency parameters, which can affect the high-frequency parameters with the flatten-structure element. In this way we can enhance the fingerprint image with keeping the global texture feature of fingerprint. The experiment results indicate that this increase effect of image-pretreatment in fingerprint image recognition is good and the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: A network intrusion detection approach combined with genetic algorithm and back propagation neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: IDS can offer protection from external users and internal attackers, where traffic doesn't go past the firewall at all. The research on IDS attempted to use neural networks for intrusion detection has been carried on and will continue. Such systems were trained on normal or attack behavior information and then detect intrusions or attacks. In this paper, we have described five kinds of Neural Network technologies that are used in IDS. An IDS combining with GA and BP is put forward, and functions of each module are detailed. Finally, a discussion of the future NN technologies, which promise to enhance the detection ability of IDS is provided.

articleTitle: Discussion on security for campus scientific research management system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: As Scientific Research level has been an important indicator of college power, it's necessary to set up scientific research management system and make daily Scientific Management more normatively and effectively. In the process of exploiting and using scientific research management system, security has always been given the first priority since it is pivotal for the survival of the system. This paper describes the status of campus Scientific research management system, analyses the current major problems and hidden dangers, proposed a viewpoint to solve the security issues, including authentication, access control, communications security and digital signatures, expected to provide some help with the management of Campus Scientific Research.

articleTitle: A novel water resources management method based on system dynamics model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The SD model we established analyzes and predicts the WRCC under four different water use modes. The results show that continuing with the present water use mode, the WRCC in Beijing will be very fragile, and cannot meet the demand of social economic development of the city in the future. As a result, the urban population will reduce gradually since 2010 and the city size will shrink. When the measures of water saving, wastewater water reuse and water transfer from other basins are implemented separately, it is still difficult to maintain rapid development of the industrial and agricultural output values as it failed to carry planned urban population growth. Only when all the measures are implemented jointly, i.e., to build a water-saving society, as well as reuse wastewater water and transfer water from other basins, the indexes of WRCC will improve steadily. In this case, the industrial output value, agricultural output value and urban population will reach their maximums in 2020.

articleTitle: A security E-government model based on service-oriented architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Internet-based E-government has become a new work model of government departments. But due to heterogeneous and autonomous between different business systems, there are barriers in E-government systems when they are interoperating. To eliminate information silos, building a unified information-sharing platform is a necessary choice for the work of the government's information. This paper studies service-oriented application integration for E-government system and proposes a security model based on identity authentication.

articleTitle: Development of a remote laboratory for process control experiments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of Internet technologies, remote access of laboratory equipment and instrument via Internet is fast becoming a reality. This paper presents the implementation of a remote laboratory experiment for process engineering education. Based on configuration software and its extended application, we investigated five essential design issues: requirement specification, system architecture, system implementation, design of monitoring interface, communication between the server and the client. Developing remote experiment system with configuration software does not require generalized programming language. It simplifies the development process and saves experimental investment. The remote laboratory supplies the students with an integrated environment of controlling the real device in the remote site and conducting the actual experiments through a computer network. In the remote laboratory, the students can receive training in engineering practice by sharing the expensive instruments and equipments.

articleTitle: Generation of organ texture with Perlin noise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Laparoscopic virtual reality based surgery simulators are becoming a ubiquitous tool in resident training and assessment. Abdominal organ surface are major visual cue of laparoscopic imagery, so it makes sense to develop algorithms of generation of texture of the abdominal organs. This paper presents a method of organ texture generation with Perlin noise. The noise function, interpolation function and smooth function are described in detail. Texture simulation of the liver and intestines, as well as fatty texture are given. Experiment results show that this method can be used to generate simple organ textures.

articleTitle: Innovation capacity teaching platform building of Electrical and Electronic course group
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Electrical and Electronic course group is a technical foundational courses for engineering students. This is due to fact that the role of these courses can make the student master the basic theory, skill, analysis and design method, and also develop their scientific and technological research and innovation ability. Therefore, the Electrical and Electronic course group of university students learning platform has been constructed based on the innovative ability. These measurements include updating the teaching philosophy, improving the educational condition and reforming the teaching model and content, etc.. The application results show that the comprehensive application ability, practical ability and innovation of the students trained by the series teaching sections have improved and these students graduated are popular by industrial units.

articleTitle: Application of MATLAB in teaching of semiconductor devices physics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Semiconductor physics is the basis for semiconductor science and technology and semiconductor devices just like the cornerstone of entire the electronics industry and the information society. Considering “Semiconductor devices physics” is an important required course of micro-electronics and other similar specialties, it is necessary to improve the teaching methods and content. With the development of the computer, it is necessary to apply computer-aided instruction in the semiconductor devices physics. It is useful for the qualitative analysis and quantitative computation with application of MATLAB software, which will help students deepen their understanding and grasp the knowledge. Utilizing the MATLAB software, students can analyze and solve many problems in semiconductor physics and devices. This article is discussed the application of MATLAB software in the course of “Semiconductor Devices Physics” in detail, including in the physics of semiconductor and the semiconductor devices. Teaching practice shows that the application of MATLAB can improve teaching effectiveness and methods effectively, can active classroom ambience and mobilize the enthusiasm of the students and the spirit of the research.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID with parameters self-turning used in the belt position departure control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Fuzzy PID with parameters self-turning control technology is applied to design a belt position departure control system to control the belt transmission. This designed system is simulated using MATLAB Simulation, and simulating results show that the response speed, overshot, self-adapting and robustness of the fuzzy controller are better than that of the traditional PID controller, and also more stable. This design is used in a real belt offset control system.

articleTitle: Research on government responsibility in energy saving and emission reducing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The theoretical basis for government accountability in energy saving and emission reduction are analyzed from public administration property, requirements of government functions, market externalities and public goods. On this basis, the government's responsibilities on energy saving and emission reduction are defined to six areas, in accordance with the problems in process of exercising the government's responsibilities, and then countermeasures and proposals are put forward, including changing the concept of the government, adjusting the economic structure, formulating policies and laws, promoting technological progress, developing recycling economy, strengthening supervision and evaluation, improving the institutional mechanisms.

articleTitle: Building an Information Quality Lab on e-health in the rural areas for healthcare education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The Information Quality Lab (IQL) is planned to develop low cost movable/mobile community e-health system for rural area. The system is built on the wireless LAN technology known as WiFi, which is the standard developed by the IEEE 802 Committee. Research framework and implementation phases in the IQL will be described in this paper. The national survey and analysis on the telecommunications environment and the needs of rural communities of the developing countries conducted by IQL will be briefly introduced. The future perspective for the development of rural communications including the applications of e-health care will also be discussed.

articleTitle: Design of a distance learning management platform based on Soft Switch technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Soft Switch is the core technology of Next Generation Networks. This paper first introduces the Soft Switch technology. Then we design a distance learning management platform based on the Soft Switch, and propose its function models and database implementation. Last, security mechanism for the platform is presented.

articleTitle: Application of EDA technology on professional teaching for electronic information engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper introduces the application of electronic design automation (EDA) technology on the professional teaching for electronic information engineering. A signal generator based on FPGA is designed with various kinds of EDA tools including PROTEL, SOPC builder and NiosII, and using VHDL to accomplish the direct digital frequency synthesize (DDS) and the interfaces of the system for example. The practicability and convenience of using EDA technology is described, and the results show that it can inspire the positive factor of the students to deepen the comprehension and cognition.

articleTitle: Application of HSMM on NC machine's state recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: It is significant to identify the running-states of NC machines for ensuring the machining accuracy and running stability. Vibration diagnosis is an on-line prognostics and diagnosis technique by picking-up the frequency characters of the vibration signal on NC machine. In the paper, combining with the wavelet noise reduction and character extraction with varying scales, the Hidden Semi-Markov model is built by the example of headstock bearing abrasion to recognize the running-states effectively. According to experiment and simulation researches, it indicates that the veracity of identification is 96.7% in the 120 test samples after training the HSMM with 80 training samples. This fault diagnosis method is satisfied for the engineering demand, and it can be applied for vibration analysis for other complex machineries.

articleTitle: Simulation of spontaneous respiration nonlinear model driven by muscle pressure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The spontaneous respiratory simulation is one main task of medical patient simulator. Based on the principle of breath, muscle pressure as source power is input into the breath system. Breath system is simulated as two lumped compartments, airway resistance and compliance. The output of the breath system is the flow of respiratory. Compared to the former method that two fixed parameters (R and C) are used as linear coefficient, we avoided the oversimplifications inherent in previous models, namely linear treatment of the breathing mechanics. Nonlinear resistance is used in this model. In order to complete the complicated model and control actuator simultaneous, LabVIEW and simulink program are used both, simulation interface toolkits (SIT) being the bridge between the two different languages. The simulated flow wave is more similar to the real breathing in that the expiratory flow is smoother than in the linear model. The parameters of R and C can be adjusted by knob in LabVIEW. And the controlling peripheral apparatus task can also be accomplished by LabVIEW DAQ card.

articleTitle: Path recognition method of agricultural wheeled-mobile robot in shadow environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper investigated the influence of the shadow environment on the path recognition for the vision navigation system of the agricultural wheeled-mobile robot. In base of path recognition in the ordinary environment, a new method based on the SOM neural network was applied to the path recognition in the shadow environment. Experimental results proved that the new method was effective on the shadow environment, and could obtain the target navigation path rapidly, reliably and accurately.

articleTitle: Using Yahoo! Pipes building Information Warehouse of Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper describes the product of Yahoo's cofiring of a RSS tool Yahoo! Pipes. We tried to use this tool to build an Information Warehouse of Intelligence. Article details the information market of the build process, including identification of sources of information, content crawling, filtering, sorting, the results of the output, as well as release and use. We identified the main source of information, intelligence in the field of Blog, and information science-related news RSS sources, domestic and foreign well-known experts and scholars in information science personal website, scientific research information, and information science-related meeting information at home and abroad, domestic and international information science major research institution websites, and information science journal articles related to library materials and other information. The key is that information is not a simple RSS feed, but by Yahoo! Pipes of the Filter module carefully screened to ensure the high quality of information.

articleTitle: Artificial immunity-based model for information system security risk evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: An artificial immunity principle based model for information system security risk evaluation is proposed. Recognition of harmful antigen by immunocytes is simulated. Immature, mature and memory detectors are defined. Evolution process of the detector is derived with math method. The math model in which the detectors recognize threats is constructed. The intensity of a threat and the vulnerability in the information system are recognized. The quantitative computation equation of security risk is deduced through the threats and vulnerabilities. The theoretical analysis shows that the proposed model provides a new approach for the information system security risk evaluation in real-time and quantity.

articleTitle: Microscopic dynamic simulation model for pedestrian-vehicle mixed traffic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The current urban transportations are mostly mixed traffic, consisting of three kinds of microscopic traffic objects: motor vehicles, non-motor vehicles and pedestrian traffic. In this paper, based on the analysis of traffic characteristics of the above objects, we construct the simulation model for motor vehicles and the cellular automata-based simulation model for pedestrian, and propose vehicle collision avoidance strategies and pedestrian avoidance strategies. This modeling method takes the similarity between models and the real world as the criterion, and effectively overcomes the problems which the accurate mathematical model encountered in mixed traffic simulation. The simulation results shows that, this method effectively simulates some characteristics of mixed traffic, and has broad application prospects in urban traffic planning, traffic demand management, traffic control and other such areas.

articleTitle: Study on the detection and correction of software based on UML
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: We have proposed an approach to the correction of anti-patterns; we believe that before attempting such corrections it is important to have confirmation from the developer. Assumptions are made when identifying or correcting certain anti-patterns; however, these assumptions that we recognize as the causes of the anti-pattern may be the behavior the developer actually intended with the design, or may not be the most optimal correction for the anti pattern. We propose these transformations as a guide for the improvement of the design; nevertheless the decision of applying the changes should be left to the user.

articleTitle: Study on the lab teaching system construction of information management and information system profession
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The talents cultivation of information management and information system profession focus on the improvement of students' practical abilities, therefore the construction of high-quality practical teaching system is extremely important, while the practical teaching relies on the construction and development of professional laboratory. Based on the focus of practical teaching, this paper proposed the thought of lab teaching system construction, and then took it as the mainline to construct five sub-systems: practical teaching objective system, practical teaching contents system, practical teaching conditions system, practical teaching management system, and practical teaching evaluation system, thus provided a distinct and feasible thought for constructing lab of information management profession.

Author Keywords: information management and information system profession

articleTitle: Applications of task-driven teaching mode in the education of digital electronics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Digital electronic technology is a very important course of electronic technical, it's traditional teaching methods are no longer adapted to the demand of their professional training. The task-driven teaching mode is built on the basis of the systematic analysis of the working process in combination with electronic design automation technology, establishing the teaching projects through objective analysis and using teaching project to design teaching task, develop, allocate resources, and establish the assessment of teaching goals process and the management system of teaching quality. With the application of task-driven method to reform of teaching methods, teaching quality has been greatly improved, the students interest in learning aroused, teaching funds saved, finally, a good study terrace for follow-up course bulit.

articleTitle: Research on reform of teaching contents and methods of “computer network” to the local university
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Computer network is a core course for students in computer science and technology major. The reform of teaching contents and methods of computer network to local university is proposed in this paper, including the following aspects: Using original edition textbook in English and adopting bilingual teaching in class; Introducing advanced contents into the course; Innovating teaching methods according student's requirement and the characteristics. It is necessary to take into account the basic theory teaching of computer network, but also pay attention to student's application skills for computer network.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The study of autonomous learning in the teaching of university physical education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Form-finding analysis and implementation of cable-reinforced membrane structure based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Morphological analysis is an important process in the design of cable-membrane structure. This article describes the analysis method of cable-membrane structure, a detailed analysis and discussion of the non-linear finite element method for form-finding method and obtain the concrete steps to use ANSYS software to achieve the form-finding analysis. Finally, through the combination of a pre-tensioned catenary mask the actual analysis of the structure, the results be calculated after the form-finding and compare theoretical values derived using ANSYS software simulation value, the maximum error between the theoretical value of 2.6%, to meet the form-finding analysis requirements.

articleTitle: The implementation and harvests of task-driven in basic computer education at university
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In terms of the particularity of basic computer education in university, this paper elaborates the author's specific implementation and related harvests of the application of task-driven method which is based on the theory of constructivism in the university in order to cultivate students' abilities in studying on their own, analyzing and solving problems, and to improve their information literacy.

articleTitle: Design of a universal enterprise Management Information System based on Web 2.0
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In the essay, with three layers of system structure, a universal enterprise Management Information System is designed and realized by employing NET and its safety authentication technology, which makes small companies information-based.

articleTitle: The study of security of E-school management information system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the popularity of network education and the development of network information management technology, the application of E-school system based on network becomes more and more extensive. On this open condition of web, the need of security of E-school management information system accordingly is higher than before. Considering on this, this article has brought out a series of security problem-solving plan based on E-school, in allusion to the characteristic of NMIS, and also analyzed the security strategy in the plan.

articleTitle: Study on the open-experimental teaching model for the purpose of cultivating innovative students
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The introduction of open experiments into study is an effective way for the innovation of traditional teaching model. The purpose lies in that the students can be cultivated with higher innovative consciousness and capability as well as related knowledge and skills. The present article discussed on the characteristic nature, the necessity and possible model of open experiments. Besides, primary practical study was carried out in our teaching process. The results exhibited that the new teaching model is feasible in practice. The new model have many advantages, for example, (i) it can bring systematic, rigorous and standard manipulative training to the students; (ii) it can also meet the demand of individuality development; (iii) the experimental labs will become the attractive place for students to study independently.

articleTitle: A design model for enterprise asset management system of coal preparation plant
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In view of variety and complexity of enterprise asset management system of coal preparation plant, the global analysis and design model is established. In addition, the modernized coal preparation plants are oriented towards interconnection and automation. It is of great necessity for the coal preparation plant to adopt the enterprise asset management. The enterprise asset management is a systematic process of planning, maintaining, upgrading, and operating physical assets cost-effectively and also an important part for the plant in organizing production. The developing of enterprise asset management system is potent activity to improve the competition of the coal preparation plant. This paper introduces a model of the enterprise asset management by means of an UML (Unified Modeling Language) methodology. In this methodology the processes are divided into two phases, and in each phase we give and discuss the essential concepts and modeling diagrams of the system such as use case diagram, activity diagram, sequence diagram, class diagram and component diagram. The incorporation of UML into model analysis for enterprise asset management is considered and shown to be practicable.

articleTitle: Research and practice on application-oriented Computer Foundation Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: High-speed evolution of computer technology in 21th century, college professors and teachers face many challenges in delivering computer foundation courses effectively for popular students in the universities. According to “Comments on Strengthening Computer Foundation Education in Colleges” and “Computer Foundation Education Course System for Universities and Colleges in China, 2006” issued by MOE (Ministry of Education) Teaching Steering Committee for Computer Science and Technology, we propose a ground rule - application-oriented computer foundation education to meet the social requirements on college students.

articleTitle: Research on application of RFID system with 2nd-generation ID card based on Zigbee wireless network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: RFID system with 2nd-generation ID card based on ZigBee wireless network is presented. The application model for RFID system in wireless network, with 2nd-generation ID card as a carrier, is supplied with ZigBee wireless network technology. The hardware circuit and software design process are given in detail.Lastly, the application methods and occasions of RFID system based on ZigBee wireless network are given.

articleTitle: Research on security of the WLAN campus network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless technology, WLAN(Wireless Local Area Network) technology is gradually integrate and replace the LAN technology, has played an important role in promoting the development of campus information technology, will be an important component in campus network. Build a stable, safe, efficient, convenient wireless campus network has become the inevitable trend of development and construction of campus network. This paper describes the main advantages of WLAN, analyses the current major problems, studies the existing security measures, proposed a viewpoint from access control, authority distribution, content filtering, data encryption, user management, log auditing and several other Security aspects, expected to provide some help with the construction of Digital Campus Network.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Exploring research of “Project-driven” teaching methods of Electronic Technology courses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The teaching exploration of the curriculum design in basis of mechanical designing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The curriculum design in basis of mechanical designing is one of the most important steps during the teaching of basis of mechanical designing, which is the practice for training students' normal mechanical designing ability and cultivating students' ability to analyze and solve engineering problems, as well as students' capability of innovation and practice. Moreover, it could exert an important influence on the learning of other courses and graduation projects. In this paper, the present state and existent problems of the curriculum design are analyzed in detail, as well as reformational necessity of the curriculum design. In order to improve the teaching quality of the curriculum design, some reform ideas and concrete methods are put forward to improve the students' capacity, such as theme choosing, task arrangement, instructional mode, students' CAD ability, students' innovation ability, oral defense and method of point rating. These methods will arouse students' interests, cultivate their cooperative capability, enhance their capability of using CAD technique, and improve their capability of communication. The teaching practice proves that these reformational methods are effective.

articleTitle: A new teaching method in human machine interface design course
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of traditional teaching method in human machine interface design course, this paper proposed a new teaching method, which according to the students characteristics of seniors, uses interaction teaching and team development to arouse the interest of students, pays great attention to practice ability as well as theory learning, promotes the students to put into practice, therefore solves the problem in traditional education method.

articleTitle: FPGA-based multi-channel CRC generator implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This article mainly describes a way of designing a parallel and highly pipelined Cyclic Redundancy Code (CRC) generator. The design can handle five different channels at an input rate of 2Gbps each. The generated CRCS are compatible with the 32-bit Ethernet standards. This circuit has been implemented with the chip EP2C35F672C6 of ALTERA using the properties of Galois Field. The synthesis results show that the design can meet the needs of high-speed data integrity check.

articleTitle: Survey and analysis of the use of social software in education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: since the emergence of social software, it greatly enhances the internet user's interpersonal communication and social interaction, also affects people's learning and education. Through the content analysis of 438 academic papers published in educational Journals from 2003 to 2008, this article summarizes the characteristics, existing problems of the educational application of various social software, and give some suggestion of it's future development.

articleTitle: Dynamic Bayesian network optimized by particle filtering in gene regulatory networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the development of bioinformatics, gene regulatory network research has gained growing more attention. The process of transcription regulation research has played a crucial role in the biomedical research. In a recent research work, the dynamic Bayesian network has become a powerful gene regulatory network modeling tool, which can show the power of the description of the relationship between complex gene regulations. However, because the vast majority of existing works simultaneously use all of the observational data on the reconstruction of the network structure and parameters optimization, so micro-array expression data in the timing characteristics have not been fully tapped. To solve the above problem, in this paper, the particle filter method is introduced into the framework of dynamic Bayesian networks algorithm, learning gene regulatory networks from the micro array expression data in sequential. By the test on brewer's yeast cell cycle microarray expression data, the algorithm is proven to be successful in capturing the dynamic characteristics of expression data. Experimental results show that compared some other works, the algorithm has higher accuracy, and can be more accurately expressed gene regulatory network structure.

articleTitle: Reform and research on experimental teaching for high frequency electronic circuit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper represents the status quo of the experimental teaching for high frequency electronic circuit, and points out the drawbacks of traditional experimental teaching. On this basis, propose hierarchical teaching contents and their corresponding experimental capacity-building programs, so that teachers can take different teaching methods and teaching evaluation systems in accordance with different levels of experimental teaching contents to cultivate students' experimental attitudes in practice. Consequently, not only the experimental teaching would achieve a favorable result, but students' experimental practical skills also are trained and upgraded during the reforms and experiments.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on teaching reform of theory and application for computer network course
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The application of morphology analysis and RFFSVM to intelligent fault diagnosis on the bearing of ships
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Support Vector Machine SVM is widely applied to fault diagnosis of machines. However, this classification method has some weaknesses. For example, it can not separate fuzzy information, particularly sensitive to the interference and the isolated points of the training samples. In view of the problems mentioned above, a random forest fuzzy SVM multi-classification algorithm (RFFSVM) has been put forward. This paper focuses on the study of the application of the Morphology Analysis and the theory RFFSVM (MA-RFFSVM) to fault diagnosis on the bearing of ships. Simulation experiments show that the algorithm has better anti-interference ability and classification effects than others. Consideration should be taken into account that it can be further applicable to the diagnosis on other mechanical faults of ships.

articleTitle: Building enterprise application based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Cloud computing promises to increase the velocity with which applications are deployed, increase innovation, and lower costs, all while increasing business agility. Based on the introduction of cloud computing layers and architecture, this paper focuses on discussing how to use cloud computing to design, build, and deliver enterprise applications with Amazon Web Services provided by Amazon. In building, paper also gives some suggestions about security considerations that enterprises must make when adopting and using cloud computing technology. At last, with heartbeat, people can build high availability enterprise application.

articleTitle: A FAQ online system based on wiki
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, we will propose a FAQ online system based on wiki engine. The goal of this system is to reduce the counseling workload in our university. It is also can be used in other counseling field. The proposed system will be built based on one of the popular wiki engines, TikiWiki. Actually, the function of the proposed system has gone far beyond the FAQ-platform functionality in practical application process, due to wiki wonderful concept and characteristics.

articleTitle: Innovation teaching method researching on embedded system course based on robot project-driven idea
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In recent years, more and more people find traditional teaching methods are unable to meet the requirements of computer education in colleges which needs related experiments. In this work, we proposed a innovation teaching method based on robot project-driven and applied this method in the teaching process of embedded system course. We design a project named “Line Tracking”, which can be decomposed into several tasks, implemented by groups of students cooperatively. Finally we provide a summary and analysis of the characteristics of this teaching mode as well as the effect of the curriculum practice. Robot project-driven method can exetremely stimulate the enthusiasm of students to involve themselves in projects design and execution.

articleTitle: The application research of computational intelligence in content video retrieval technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Along with the unceasing development of computer, communication and multi-media technology and rapid growth of video information, How to effectively depending on the video data to organize, manage, expression and retrieval that becomes the hot issue in video retrieval research field. The paper discusses the feature extraction of video shot boundary detection, researches and analyzes the general method of shot cut detection, then propose the support vector machine based on shot cut detection method. This method makes use of support vector machine Good generalization ability of learning and the characteristics of the lens shear, structural support vector machine classifier, to achieve shot cut detection. It reduced the number of the experience reading and the resulting influence of human factors. Simulation experiments test video clips with different characteristics have achieved good results, through comparison of test results with other methods proved the validity of research methods.

articleTitle: Research of formal modelling based on UML'package and B
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the difficulties of conversion between UML and B, and proposes a system of formal modelling to overcome the difficulties and get a simply proving obligation. Then, an instance is realized for describing the whole process.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on therapeutic effect of music therapy on patients with dental anxiety of College Students
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: DRP-DHT: Semi-distributed resource sharing model for P2P real-time streaming media
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose DRP-DHT, a semi-distributed P2P resource sharing model. This model improves the degree of perception of space and time of the system through double ID identity, enhances the efficiency of query through the multi-layered topology. We apply DRP-DHT to DRPSS, a P2P system that provides both live and time-shifted streams, experimental results show that our DRP-DHT significantly reduces the system's routing delay and maintenance overhead, effectively enhances the service quality.

articleTitle: Study of bilingual teaching for physics experiment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The English-Chinese bilingual teaching in the physics experiment course is a significant approach to foster innovational talents in the new century in China. The applicability and feasibility of bilingual teaching in the course of physics experiment and the obstacles facing in the process of implementation are discussed. Various approaches and methods to overcome these difficulties and obtain better teaching effects from many aspects such as teaching materials, teachers, teaching method and students are presented. It is concluded that practice has proved the worth of bilingual teaching in physics experiment.

articleTitle: A fast object segmentation approach based on integral image in ALV system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In ALV system, the object segmentation approach is one of the most important research fields for object detection. In this paper, a simple and fast object segmentation approach is proposed for ALV system. Firstly, a binarizaton method based on integral image is applied to binarize the input images; Secondly, in order to save the computation time of gray mean of each pixels in squared window, a method of reduce the redundant computation is applied in our algorithm; After that, the “holes” in object are filled by inner-filling algorithm; Lastly, the filled images are segmented by using easy edge detection approach. Several experiment images of ALV system is used to verify the proposed algorithm, the result indicate that the approach is valid and feasible.

articleTitle: Concept learning embedded in a freshman engineering project on energy scavenging
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper describes a freshman engineering hands-on project where students design and build a vibrating system that is used to perform energy scavenging experiments. By working on this project students become familiar with important engineering concepts, such as signal amplitude and frequency, in a simple manner. They also gain experience and an appreciation of standard engineering design practices. The pre- and post-processing survey shows that students increase their basic understanding of basic engineering concepts. In their reflection papers most students expressed a great deal of satisfaction with the project. A common concern stated in those papers was the large amount of time dedicated to successfully complete the various required tasks.

articleTitle: Studies on internet real-name system and network action surveillance system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper puts forward a methodology of building network action surveillance system and a concept of knowledge base in active real-name system and automatic surveillance system. The purpose of this paper is to develop an effective evaluation model for network behaviours based on the actual situation of China, through analysis and study of privacy law to establish a real-name system for users of active participation and an automatic surveillance system, and develop an automatic surveillance system based on protocol, behavioral data and model,and this system can self-integrate and self-expand.

articleTitle: A reliability transmission routing metric algorithm for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: A reliability transmission routing metric algorithm based on ETX was proposed, which aimed at the limited energy and the special requirement of transmission reliability for wireless sensor network. This paper finds the several key characteristics of wireless sensor networks communication link, such as high loss rate, obvious asymmetry, according to the experimental study. From these, an energy efficient and reliable routing metric algorithms is provided. Then the routing metric proposed in the paper is adopted to improve the traditional AODV routing protocol. Simulation results show that this algorithm is an excellent routing metric for improving reliability transmission.

articleTitle: Development and realization of corrosion heating equipment on oil pipeline
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In order to deeply buried oil pipeline corrosion protection for high reliability, the first oil pipeline needs to be heated to 200 degrees. The traditional heating method is to use the flame barbecue, in order to save energy, improve product quality, using principles of electromagnetic induction heating, medium frequency times the voltage inverter technology, current-voltage negative feedback technology, oil pipeline corrosion heating equipment was developed, all the technical indicators of the product reached the design requirements ,and it have been put into use. Practice shows that the system design is reasonable, good performance.

Author Keywords: medium frequency inverter times the voltage

articleTitle: Discussion on teaching method of Tolerancing Principles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Tolerancing Prisnciples is one of the education difficulties of the basic Technology of Exchangeability Measurement. For achieving better education purpose, the paper introduced a kind of education ways which was based on the content of the course and writer's education practice. The teaching method of tolerancing principles included adjustment and selection of teaching content, focusing on the concept teaching, using guided teaching method, using interactive teaching method, using multimedia teaching method, and consolidating classroom teaching effect. Those teaching methods had helped students deepen their understanding of the the basic concepts of tolerancing principles, and improve the abilities of their analysis and solving problem.

articleTitle: Securing IEEE 802.11 based hybrid wireless mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In recent years, mesh networking has emerged as a key technology for the last mile Internet access and found to be an important area of research. The current draft standard of IEEE 802.11s has defined routing for Wireless Mesh Networks (WMNs) in layer-2 and is termed as Hybrid Wireless Mesh Protocol (HWMP). However, security in routing or forwarding functionality is not specified in the standard. The protocol does not provide authentication and integrity of routing messages which makes it vulnerable to many attacks. As a consequence, the routing protocol in its current form is vulnerable to various types of routing attacks. In this paper, we propose modified HWMP routing protocol for WMN which uses cryptographic extensions to protect unprotected routing information elements. We will show that the proposed protocol successfully prevents all the identified attacks.

articleTitle: Chaotic Clonal Selection Algorithm for function optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The chaotic initialization and chaotic search are introduced into Clonal Selection Algorithm (CSA) to overcome random antibody initialization and premature convergence problems in traditional CSA. Taking full advantages of the ergodic and stochastic properties of chaotic variables, antibodies with different affinity perform chaotic search to exploit local solution space. Experimental results on test functions demonstrate that the chaotic CSA outperforms the classical clonal selection algorithm.

articleTitle: A fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method on E-commerce training platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The training of E-commerce talents is inseparable from a scientific and systematic training platform. At present, there are hundreds of E-commerce training platforms with different features available in the market; however, we put forward a multi-level comprehensive assessment system based on the theory of fuzzy, characterized in scientificity, accuracy, comprehensiveness and objectivity, enabling the provision of the support to the teaching institutions in the selection of platforms. In the paper, we design the evaluation index system based on the practical needs of E-commerce teaching, establish multi-factor comprehensive evaluation model and verify the model effect by experiments.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of management information system based on VC++
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Management information system mainly includes setting up and maintenance of backstage supporter's database and development of front application program. The former demands setting up database. The latter requires the function of its procedure is complete. SQL language principle, VC++ used and designed program and SQL Server2000 database technology has carried on the deeper study and application, finish to get accommodation demand of administrative system analyses function module divided, the database mode is analyzed mainly, and has designed structure of the database and application program from this.

articleTitle: Educational experience of computer and network based teaching approach to electrical engineering curriculums
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The focus of the present work is on introducing the computer and network based teaching approach to electrical engineering curriculums. These techniques not only help to expand the teaching contents and improve the learning effects, but also can cultivate the self-learning of the students and construct the interactive learning environments. The education experiences of computer simulation of adjustable speed AC drive system curriculum, the web based system simulation platform for automatic control curriculum and FTP site based microcontroller course design were presented and analyzed as examples. The practice results provide an overview of the teaching approach. It is expected that this approach can be helpful to the education study and reform on the engineering curriculums of higher education level.

articleTitle: Research and implementation English Morphological Analysis and Part-of-Speech tagging
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: English Morphological Analysis (MA) and Part-of-Speech (POS) tagging are key task in natural language processing (NLP) and computational linguistics. This research and application are of great theoretical and practical significance. English Morphological Analysis (MA), Part-of-Speech (POS) tagging and Phrase Dictionary Retrieval (PDR) are essential steps in the course of NLP. And they are difficult in NLP. Their results are decisive to the accuracy of next processing, such as information searching, information filtration. As separate problems of English, MA, POS, PDR can be considered independent with each other. In a practical research system, however, they are dependent: solution of the prior one forms the base for processing the next one. Considering different features of these problems in this thesis, after a comprehensive study, a divide-and-conqueror strategy is proposed and resolves them separately. First, a knowledge-based method is put forward for the solution of MA. The whole MA processing is completed by many subordinate functions dealing with different particular marks of English words. A strategy of combining the word length with statistic enumeration is developed to distinguish between the periods and abbreviations.

articleTitle: The research of project teaching method in Technique and Application of Database teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: According to the current situation of Technique and Application of Database (TAD) teaching, we introduce project teaching method into the course teaching combining the practical teaching experiences in this paper. Through the well-designed project, we cultivate students from the aspects of teaching, exercise and training. The practical results show that this new teaching model shortens the distance between teaching and practice. It achieves a good result.

articleTitle: A new Half-overlap Filtered Multitone Modulation based on CIC filter in the context of Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, an analysis of multicarrier (MC) communication technique in the context of Cognitive Radio is realized. The features of alternative modulation based on filter bank-non-overlap and Half-overlap subchannel Filtered MultiTone (FMT) will be mentioned. However, half-overlap FMT system proposed in [6] introduces intercarrier interference (ICI) due to the loss of orthogonality which may reduce system performance. In order to keep subcarriers orthogonal and thereby eliminate ICI, an improved Half-overlap FMT system with orthogonal subcarriers based on cascaded integrator-comb (CIC) filter will be proposed and a comparison will be conducted. Both the simulation and measure results show that the proposed modulation technique is a good candidate for Cognitive Radio.

articleTitle: Study on underwater image segmentation technique
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Underwater image segmentation is an important technique for underwater machine vision and underwater resources exploration. For the complexity of imagery underwater image segmentation is more difficult that that for common images. Methods on underwater image segmentation are studied. The advantages and limitations of each algorithm are discussed. Future searching trends for underwater image segmentation are given.

articleTitle: The application of improved boosting algorithm in neural network based on cloud model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: An effective ensemble should consist of a set of networks that are both accurate and diverse. Ensemble learning is an algorithm to improve the generalization ability of the unstable classifier. We propose an improved boosting algorithm based on cloud model for constructing neural network ensemble, where cloud model is used to classify trained networks according to similarity and optimally select the most accurate individual network from each cluster to make up the ensemble. Empirical studies on regression of typical datasets showed that this approach yields significantly smaller ensemble achieving better performance than other traditional ones such as Bagging and Boosting. The bias variance decomposition of the predictive error shows that the success of the proposed approach may lie in its properly tuning the bias/variance trade-off to reduce the prediction error.

articleTitle: The construction research on Rapid-Response Eco-Supply Chain of the textile industry based on the circular economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: China is a power country in the textile production and trading. But comprehensive perspective on the development of China's textile industry, we find that it is not free from extensive growth mode, and is still an industry with more serious environmental pollution in our country. As to some problems which existed in the rapid development of China's textile industry, this paper put forward the basic concept of the Rapid-Response Eco-Supply Chain of the textile industry according to the basic theory and operation principle of the circular economy, and analyzed that's very important to construct the Rapid-Response Circular Supply Chain for sustainable development of China's textile industry and overcoming the “green” trade barriers.
