Finally, the main content of the construction research is elaborated.

articleTitle: “Semiconductor physics” construction in microelectronics and teaching discussion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The core of key course constructions is consist of content and course system construction. Based on the features and problems occurred in the teaching practice of “semiconductor physics”, together with the need from constructions of key courses within microelectronics major in the school, the article makes feasible construction and revolution, combining the theory and experiment of various teaching, to train the activity and creative mind of students.

articleTitle: Study of communication between VFP and Mitsubishi FX serial PLC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper briefly introduces hardware connection, serial port settings, operation commands and control characters in the serial communication between computer and FX Programmable logic controller (PLC) programming port, and it also presents in detail the message format, operation address and communication program written by Visual FoxPro (VFP) during four operations such as Force ON, Force OFF, Read and Write.

articleTitle: Study on influencing factors of E-business user Personalization recommendation technology acceptance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, the influence factor of E-business users Personalization recommendation technology acceptance is deeply researched and discussed. The influence factor model of E-business users Personalization recommendation technology acceptance is build and verified by empirical research.

articleTitle: State-space transition for unforced nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: To unforced nonlinear systems, based on the state equation of control systems, the definition of state space transition is given. First of all, the state space transition of the system is obtained by utilizing the solution of related linear homogeneous equation; then based on the differential equation in series forms, the state space transition of the state equation of the unforced nonlinear system is given by heuristic method. The method in this paper can be used to the design of nonlinear control systems.

articleTitle: Analog circuits course reform and practice in the teachers college of technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The analog circuits course is an important elementary course in the electronic engineering specialty. The study mainly introduces the analog circuits course reform in the teachers college of technology, including the reform of theoretical teaching, practical teaching management, and examination of the experimental operations. Practice has proved that rational application of modern educational technology and the electronic design automation (EDA) software can effectively resolve the “difficult beginning” problem of the analog circuits course, and can closely integrate theoretical teaching with practical teaching. The study also introduces the implemental situations of the practical separation of teaching and testing.

articleTitle: A dynamic priority assignment strategy for real-time task
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Most of the real-time task scheduling algorithms assign the priorities of tasks according to their three attributes, deadlines, slack times and value(density), but seldom synthetically analyze the effects of the three factors on the priorities of tasks. This paper studies the dynamic value density and urgency of a task by studying its three attributes, and based on which, a dynamic priority assignment strategy, DPA, is proposed. In this strategy, two parameters p and q are used to adjust the weight that the value density and urgency of a task impact on its priority. Finally, the result of simulations shows that a scheduler using DPA strategy could improve the gained-value of the system, reduce the deadline miss ratio.

articleTitle: An autonomous and collaborative CAI learning system for university physics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Based on the constructivist learning theory, and in close combination with the construction of exquisite course “university physics” of Zhejiang province, we established a network-based autonomous and collaborative CAI learning system. It offers the users a new learning environment, in which the students and teachers are able to communicate efficiently. When implemented to the instruction of university physics, the practical results of this system prove to be very effective.

articleTitle: DTI white matter fiber tractography using bayesian framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Diffusion tensor-MRI (DTI) White matter fiber tracking traces white matter fibber bundle and its image according to the diffusion of water molecular in the white matter. This paper uses structure information of fiber bundle and DTI information in current voxel to estimate the probability density function of the tracking direction to the next voxel. This algorithm is under the framework of Bayesian decision and uses weighted sampling to get the tracking result. Stochastic three dimension image of topologic and spatial information of white matter fiber bundle was demonstrated through multiply tracking and was applicant in real DTI data.

articleTitle: The generalization and transplantation of Stewart theorem in three dimensional space
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, we give two generalized theorem of Stewart theorem and give some examples to show how to use them in solving complicated competition problems. And then we extend the theorem to the 3-dim space and get the transplantation theorem.

articleTitle: Application of the character extraction with mutative scales on states recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The Numerical Control technology is applied to the high-accuracy mechanical working widely. So it is very important to monitor its states in time to ensure the maching accuracy. In the paper, a new states recognition method is proposed to improve the precision of state recognition. Firstly, the character extraction with mutative scales is applied to achieve the characteristic values. Secondly, the Hidden Semi-Markov model is built to identify the different runing states. Thirdly, the new method is compared with the traditional one by the example of abrasion of the headstock bearing in NC machines. According to the simulation and experiment researches, it indicates that the signal characters with more state information can be obtained pertinently by using the character extraction with mutative scales. And the accuracy of recognition is 98.44% in the 192 test samples, improved evidently than the traditional one. And the new character extraction method can be used in the technology domain widely.

articleTitle: Study on personnel training model and curriculum system construction in GIS specialty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Geography Information System is a new-emerging interdisciplinary discipline. With booming development of GIS specialty undergraduate education, undergraduate employment problems of GIS specialty have been exposed. In order to solve this problem, GIS specialty personnel training goal, model and curriculum system construction are deeply researched and discussed. Taken Nanjing University of posts and telecommunications as an example, GIS specialty personnel training model and curriculum scheme construction are studied and practiced.

articleTitle: Research on the integrity monitoring of GPS Vehicle System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the further developing of country, the Vehicle System seems to be more complicated and important in recent year. Thus the valid monitoring upon vehicle turns to be crucial to the management of Vehicle System transportation. This paper works out a Integrity Monitoring of GPS Vehicle System through the illustration of research of the GPS and its management system.

articleTitle: Analysis on the self-estimation of students' learning quality in network teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Making self-estimation in network teaching is not only an important stage for students, but also an important method for checking the learning quality. This article states the aim and content of self-estimation in network teaching,and it takes a network curriculum in Virtual Learning Community of Capital Normal University as an example to discuss its effect on learning quality, taking four aspects that is to say: participation, interaction, resource utility and master of knowledge, and it hopes to provide some reference for improving learning quality.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Target hierarchy methodology applied in mechatronical engineering bilingual teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Development of the DSP experiment system based on TMS320F2407 and XC95144
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: DSP control and relative technologies have attracted the attention of multi-disciplines engineering researchers and educators, and are becoming a new and active field. Think over the characteristic of DSP course teaching, this article developed the DSP experimental system based on the chip of TMS320LF2407 and XC95144. The experimental system mainly consists of a TMS320LF2407 chip, peripherals on board, signal collection and disposal circuit, CPLD circuit and so on.. The development process of DSP software is introduced in detail and part of experiment waveform is supplied. The experimental results show the DSP experimental system have perfect function and run stably.

articleTitle: Study on the construction process management and control of cable stayed bridge based on MIDAS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The cable stayed bridge is one of the main types of long span bridge with greater crossover capability and a good economical benefit. Introduced the structural analysis theory of cable stayed bridge construction control, summarized the simulation analysis methods of cable stayed bridge construction control, and described their own characteristic. The structure simulation analysis and calculation during the construction of the bridge is processed by using the large-scale general-purpose finite element analysis software MIDAS. Introduced the construction phase analysis function of the MIDAS/Civil, and select the appropriate element model to simulate the different components of the cable stayed bridge: using beam element of considering the shearing action to simulate the main beam, the Cable Support Tower and the bridge piers, using truss element to simulate the cable stayed lock, using the equivalent load method to simulate the effect of prestressing force of steel in the main beam and the suspended wagon in the bridge construction. Corresponding solutions have been put forward for the effect of non-linear factors for the construction control of cable stayed bridges.

articleTitle: Teaching design and multimedia teaching resources development using information processing theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: For the sake of building the theoretical system of the designing course teaching, developing multimedia teaching resources to correspond with the teaching rules of higher education. Based on theoretical analysis, this paper investigates the technologies including teaching design and multimedia teaching resources development and provides the principles and requirements, process of design and development, evaluation on effectiveness of design and development, that promotes the reform of higher-education teaching methods.

articleTitle: An accumulated method based on fractal for automatic terrain generation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, an accumulated method for automatic terrain generation was proposed which was based on the fractal theory. The Fault formation algorithm is used to generate an initial model of terrain. By controlling the iteration and amplitude of Fault formation, we can get diversified Contoured Terrain. Then the MPD (Middle Point Displacement) method of fractal theory is used to iterate the initial model, which results in more terrain details. The main advantage of the method is the combination of automaticity and controllability. On the one hand, Terrain Feature Templates can be automatically generated by the various values of the parameters of Fault formation. On the other hand, arbitrary level detail can be produced by the various values of the Fractal parameters. The experiments prove that our method is feasible and valid and the realistic terrain can be generated through the method.

articleTitle: Study of RLT-enhancements for minimax optimization problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper addresses the development of enhanced representations for the rich class of minimax mixed-integer 0-1 optimization on problems that typically arise in the context of a broad spectrum of applications encompassing mechanical and design engineering, machine and sports scheduling, and facility location, to name a few. In this paper, we study the development of enhanced formulations for the general class of minimax mixed-integer 0-1 optimization problems using the unified optimization framework offered by the Reformulation-Linearization Technique (RLT). We also propose various Lagrangian dual formulations for the RLT-enhanced formulations.

articleTitle: Teaching reform of “Automatic Control Theory” course for the independent college students
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: According to the characters of relatively weak cultural foundation though the overall quality relatively high of independent college students, the “Automatic Control Theory” teaching reform ideas and methods are proposed combining with long-term teaching experience and the application of network and information technology. The curriculum reform includes many aspects such as teaching content, teaching mode, and practice areas, assessment models and so on. From many years teaching practice process, it can be seen that students' learning effectiveness and engineering practice abilities are improved greatly by using these teaching reforms.

articleTitle: Bayesian filter based on Anti-Spam Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Due to the gradual increasing of spam's harm to the society, the anti-spam technology has been the focus of attention of all sectors. In this paper, we bring forward the Bayesian filter technology based on Anti-Spam Grid, which can realize the cooperation among various servers and comprehensive utilization of grid resources, and ultimately improve the accuracy and efficiency of spam filtering. We analyze the Anti-Spam Grid, design and implement the grid-based Bayesian filter, and experimentally verify the effect of the filtering system.

articleTitle: Tentative idea of reform on the second classroom for electronic specialty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: For the college students who are receiving their higher education in campuses, the second classroom, which has unique advantages and is rich in content, is a very important means to improve their comprehensive quality. Moreover, this education mode is playing an important role in cultivating inter-disciplinary and application-oriented talents, further activating students' abilities in scientific research, practice, innovation and solving practical problems, enhancing academic atmosphere in campuses, and arousing students' sense of teamwork, thereby enabling talents to come to the fore.

articleTitle: The research of training model of CAX comprehensive ability for mechanical major
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: CAX knowledge penetrates into the entire life cycle of products, enterprise require technical personnel to solve problems in various stages by using CAX knowledge. For the demand of enterprises for qualified personnel, universities should take effective measures to train students' CAX comprehensive ability in mechanical major. The scientific curriculum is the basis of training students' CAX comprehensive ability. And the rich teaching methods are effective means to ensure teaching quality. In order to ensure students to master CAX comprehensive knowledge and use it, the innovative evaluation system should also be taken for students.

articleTitle: Probe into the university multimedia teaching courseware development mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Courseware development mode expresses the principle of courseware development. This paper studies the ideas and methods of courseware design through teaching courseware development mode perspective, mainly including four stages as teaching aim design, teaching content design, courseware composition and production and teaching effect feedback and evaluation. The ideas and processes meet the needs of teaching and improve the teaching quality for reflecting the thinking of progressive approach and individualized. It has an important and direct guiding role for the courseware developers.

articleTitle: Unstructured information organization based on ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper proposes the method to develop domain ontology's DB, based on the ontology's DB, utilizes ontology's to annotate unstructured information and translate unstructured information into structured information, so that facilitates the retrieval of unstructured information. The experiment results show that rule-based retrieval has better recall and shorter retrieval time than fact-based retrieval and relationship -based retrieval.

articleTitle: Study on GIS specialty practice teaching system construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Geographical Information System is technological and comprehensive interdiscipline. A scientific and rational practice teaching system is a guarantee for training innovative GIS talents. Taking Nanjing University of Post and Telecommunications as an example, centred around our school GIS specialty personnel training objective and characteristics, the intension, construction principles, basic frames, content structure and concrete examples of the practice teaching system were introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Study of antecedent and consequences of work group learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The organizational and individual levels of analysis dominate most research about learning in organizations. Group level learning has generally been neglected. In this paper, we first study group learning modes, the extent and frequency with which group learning processes are used. Then, antecedents of work group learning are presented. Finally, we study consequences of work group learning.

articleTitle: Research on the multi-dimensional teaching model of Automobile Construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, for the problems in the speciality courses teaching, Combined with the course features of “Automobile Construction” and the speciality characteristics of Vehicle Engineering Program, a new teaching model—multi-dimensional teaching model is proposed. The model can make full use of a variety of teaching resources to carry out three-dimensional teaching from various aspects, so as to effectively promote the teaching quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: Approach to congestion pattern analysis based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: How to improve the user experience for the networks is a problem should be extensively concerned about. In this paper, an approach to networks congestion analysis model based on Bayesian Network is proposed to realize the network system operation and maintenance effectively. Compare to the networks topology, the congestion pattern networks is constructed and each congestion object's conditional probability table and the joint probability distribution can be calculated according to the network data flow. The dependency between the congestion nodes can be presented and we can find the abnormal point in the networks topology. Experiment is conducted to verify the correctness and validity of the proposed method, and the results indicate that it is effective to construct the congestion pattern model with Bayesian Network, and it can be able to dig out the potential congestion path more accurately.

articleTitle: Imperfection and improvement of multimedia technology in the teaching of university physics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Application of multimedia technology in the teaching of university physics is a certainly tendency, multimedia teaching as a new model is adopted by many teachers of university, which is beneficial supplement in the traditional teaching, but it usually appears some problems and imperfection, such as teaching contents, teaching rhythm, teaching methods. If gain satisfied teaching effect, we must realize the imperfection of multimedia technology in the teaching, then improve the imperfection by enhancing PowerPoint, controlling the teaching rhythm, combining the model between traditional teaching and multimedia teaching.

articleTitle: Research on the integrated teaching model about “detection technology”
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Nowadays, all-round development and lifelong development is necessary for a talented person, accompanying the evolution of science and technology. Therefore, we should pay attention to learning ability and applying ability in the process of personnel training, at the same time, give the whole attention to intersection and amalgamation among various knowledge. In order to adapt to the high-speed development in the field of detection technology and satisfy the society's high call for the applying ability of engineering course students, the research of educational reform about “Detection Technology” has been carried out. The integrated teaching model—“teaching, learning, doing” aims at training the students' project consciousness and capability of anglicizing and solving problems.

articleTitle: The application of rough set theory in remote sensing image classification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Rough set theory is a relatively new mathematical tool to deal with imprecise, incomplete and inconsistent data. The content of this paper is twofold. First, to decrease computational time, band reduct is performed on multispectral remote sensing image using rough set and information entropy. Second, image classification is obtained after band reduction, Gaussian mixture model and EM algorithm are considered. The algorithm designed in this paper can make bands reduction and multispectral remote sensing image classification unsupervised. Experimental results show that the proposed method did have effective and valid performance.

articleTitle: Study of variance-based model of Organizational Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Organizational learning is a continuous process of value/knowledge integration that may take place through informative, interactive, and cooptative modes. In this paper, we study the variance based model, and introduce Process Model of Organizational Learning. The process model outlines the learning process and may also explain the anomalies found while comparing the penetration rate and survey data analysis. The variance based model seeks to explain differential learning among LDSSs (the local departments of social services), by measuring the presence or absence of a learning environment in these organizations.

articleTitle: Real-time human heart rate monitoring using a wireless sensor network based on stochastic resonance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Heart rate plays an important part in human health monitoring. In this paper, a synchronized intelligent sensor network was proposed for heart rate monitoring. The stochastic resonance method was utilized to process the sensor network data and monitor the cardiac status continually during. The experimental results showed that the system presented an effective solution for a large scale human health estimation.

articleTitle: The design of mobile robot heading control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The paper took the wireless sensor networks as background and studied navigation and location of mobile robot. The heading angle determination and course control theory for the mobile robot were studied and course control system composed of HMC1022 chip was designed too. It can achieve the heading angle determination and course control. No matter which direction the robot moves, it can change the direction to run with the course control system. Moreover, the current heading angle can be shown on the computer. The control angle also can be given from the computer.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study on the major factors influencing market demand of China's professional basketball competition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Period of social transition into the Chinese Professional Basketball Club, the Tmpact of factor analysis and revenue
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the network security of a web-based E-University system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the development of education information management technology and the improvement of computer-network technology, the application of E-University system based on network becomes more and more extensive. On this condition, the need of security of web-based E-University system accordingly is higher than before. The paper firstly introduces the actuality and preventing measure of the network security briefly, then presents the establishment of this network security system based on the E-University system, which includes visit control, transmit control and server security control etc.

articleTitle: Defect recognition algorithm based on curvelet moment and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, a new recognition algorithm based on curvelet moment and support vector machine(SVM) is proposed for chip defect recognition. The proposed recognition method is implemented through a reference comparison method. First the defect regions of chips are extracted through preprocessing, and then the curvelet moment feature of the defect region is computed as the input of SVM classifier, the output of the trained SVM classifier is the result of defect recognition. The algorithm combines the good properties of curvelet moment and SVM classifier, the former can provide multi-scale, local details and orientation information of the defect region, and the latter is suitable to solve the small samples, nonlinear and high dimensions pattern recognition problem. Experimental results show that the algorithm has higher recognition rate compared with PCA based method and can solve the complex defects recognition problem effectively.

articleTitle: Integrating mobility, multi-homing and security in universal network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In current network, IP address is used to represent both a host's identity and a host's topological location. This overloading makes mobility and multi-homing hard from the security point of view. In this paper we show in universal network how to solve the end-host mobility and end-host multi-homing problems, and introduce a signalling protocol to solve the security problems caused by mobility and multi-homing. Basically, universal network introduces a new architecture, in which AID is used to represent the identity of the host, RID is used to denote the topological location of the host, breaking the fixed binding between identities and locations.

articleTitle: GIS-based dynamic analysis of land-use change and its ecological effects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Remote Sensing (RS) and Geographic Information System (GIS) are important technologies for the sustainable management of ecological environment. In this paper, Landuse information is obtained by integrating the maximum likelihood classification (MLC) and neural network classification (NNC) method, which can realize the automatic extraction and recognition of land-use in Beijing City from remote sensing data. The characteristics of land-use and its ecological effects are quantified by developing regional ecological value index (EVI) and transfer rate of the ecological value (TREV). The results show that land-use information obtained by the combinative methodology of MLC and NNC is accurate, the land-use change closely associated with the rapid development and the urbanization. The EVI and TREV can make quantitative evaluation for the ecological environment and its evolution direction. From 1996 to 2005, the EVI in study area shows a downward trend. This result would be useful for establishing better future management strategies for ecological environment in urban-rural transition zones.

articleTitle: Analyse of American academic game courses in computer science education and guidance for domestic universities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Computer games are more and more popular and have grown to be a large industry, but game talents are lack and training mechanism is not yet perfect in our country. In order to solve this problem, it is necessary to develop game courses or specialty in domestic universities. In this paper, we analyze ways for integrating games into computer science curricula in several world-famous universities whose experience can be used for reference to us. With the guidance, some advices and conceptions are given for developing games in domestic universities, taking Beihang University as an example.

articleTitle: Small and medium-sized enterprises electronic commerce development problem and countermeasure analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the environment improvement of electronic commerce in China, electronic commerce of small and medium-sized enterprises also marches into the stage of practical development. To acquire comprehensive and thorough knowledge of the status quo of small and medium-sized enterprises electronic commerce, this thesis based on the data of electronic commerce of large-scale enterprises collected by famous domestic and foreign investigation institutes, illustrates the features and problems of electronic commerce development of small and medium-sized enterprise in China, and analyzes the factors for promoting the development.

articleTitle: The development of air-conditioning system design load calculation software
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide professional service for the undergraduate education of Building environment and equipment engineering, based on the professional Curriculum project and Graduate project. According to cooling-wet load calculation principle of air-conditioning system, by the VB programming language, it is designed and developed cooling-wet load calculation software of air-conditioning system. The basic composition and functions of the software was detailed described in this paper.

articleTitle: The study of college physics teaching under the network circumstance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper discusses the teaching innovation of the college physics under the network circumstance in three facets, such as the teaching materials, a multifunctional teaching platform and the teaching ideas and methods. The college physics teaching under the network circumstance is one of good ways to improve the quality and efficiency of teaching in the modern times.

articleTitle: Three-level direct torque control of salient pole synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The mathematical model of salient pole synchronous motor has been given. The principle of three-level direct torque control of salient pole synchronous motor is analysed. The synthesis method principle of virtual synthesis phase has been given in detail. Some simulation waveforms which based on the virtual synthesis method of three-level direct torque control of salient pole synchronous motor have been given. The simulation results show that the program has some advantages, such as low torque ripple and fast response. So it has some actual value.

articleTitle: The reform and practice on communication electronic circuit course
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Communication electronic circuit course is a specialized basic course in electronic information specialty, which plays an important role in electronic discipline. In this paper, we analyze the existing problems during the teaching, and present our reform measures and practices in teaching idea, teaching content, teaching method and means, etc., which has effectively improved teaching quality and course construction.

articleTitle: A research of high-speed Batcher's odd-even merging network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Batcher's odd-even merging network can be easily implemented on hardware. And its parallel working between the comparator is very beneficial to play the advantages of hardware such as high efficiency and high speed. These make it as the most widely used sort algorithm. In this paper, FPGA is used to implement Batcher's odd-even merging network, solving the problems of traditional design. And the scalability of Batcher's odd-even merging network is also studied in this paper. The end results show that Batcher's odd-even merging network can be used to not only sort and classify the data, but also fast complete the parallel data packets distribute.

articleTitle: Integrating computer technologies into college English teaching in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Computer technologies have been used in college English teaching more and more widely. With the college English teaching reform being carried out, computer technologies will show more advantages in college English teaching. This paper presents a relatively extensive view on the integration of computer technologies in college English teaching. First, how to use computer technologies to make effective courseware is introduced through analyzing some unsuccessful PowerPoint courseware. Then, this paper probes into the process of computer technology integration in college English classrooms equipped with traditional interactive blackboard, and discusses some potential problems related to the use of computer technologies in the language classroom. Thirdly, as the assignments and after-class reading are important to language teaching, this paper summaries some ideas and techniques for the students to communicate with teachers. Finally, it is proposed that teachers should change their views toward integrating computer technologies in college English teaching.

articleTitle: Credit assessment for listed companies based on GA-BP model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper first constructed a financial index system for credit assessment of listed companies, then analyzed the defects of BP neural network model and found out it is easy to fall into the defect of local optical solution. By introducing the revised connection weight value of genetic algorithms, constructed GA-BP neural network model, and selected 80 companies listed from 2004 to 2007 as training samples, another 80 listed companies as test samples, to evaluate after screening indicators. The result shows high accuracy on assessment by using this model.

articleTitle: A CDIO-based teaching quality monitoring system for computer science and technology specialty at private universities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Engineer shortage and quality of engineering education is now a common problem, which requires engineering education reform urgently. The CDIO engineering education model is developed to solve this problem by setting a set of systematic, generic and feasible teaching standards for all engineering education areas. To reform the current engineering education system and establish a complete set of training methods, a comprehensive reform is necessary in key aspects such as teaching management, evaluation mechanisms and so on. This paper takes for instance a CDIO-based computer science and technology specialty education reform, on top of the already built ABET-based teaching quality monitoring system, combining the education practice at the Dalian Neusoft Institute of Information, discusses methods for continuously improving the teaching quality and transforming daily education activities with the help of CDIO philosophy.

articleTitle: CAD course discussion of content and teaching method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: CAD technology was used more and more widely in different area, Students must learn the basic skill of CAD because universities' courses and job market want to concern with requires of students closely. This article emphasized the contents which contain the basic theory and application skill from CAD course content; during teaching course, it focused to encourage students' enthusiasm with methods of discussion and participation, especially united specialty and scientific research subject application of CAD technology, exerted students' creativeness and conscious activity sufficiently, improved teaching effect obviously.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Mineral processing machinery curriculum reform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A brief analysis on data encryption's application in electronic business transaction security
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Electronic business transaction security involves confidentiality , integrity indefensibility and identity conformity. Data encryption technology and its relevant applied technology including digital envelop , digital abstract , digital signature , digital timestamp, digital certificate , security transaction agreement and so on, which proved playing an important role in the electronic business security and promoting favorable development .

articleTitle: The research of solid waste management system in Dongguan City based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: How to use the information technology to improve solid waste management has become a social hot issue of environment protection and resources protection. This paper chose Dongguan City as the study area, discussed the construction goal of waste management system, and designed the waste information system based on GIS. The study would boost the solid waste management reform, and improve its management level and efficiency. It was helpful for other environmental management information system, and it could also be used as a good example in the national implementation. The research would boost pollution sources reform, and improve its management level and efficiency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research of dynamic hierarchical teaching method in computer based on diversity of individual attributes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)

articleTitle: The stability of a new Lü chaotic system with a sort of parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Implusive stabilzation for control and synchronization of chaotic systems can be applied in secure communication. Lü's chaotic system is founded by Lü and chen in 2002 and its synchronization control theory can be the kernel technology in Lü's chaos-based secure communication. In this paper we propose a scheme's synchronization of Lü's chaotic system with a special oscillating parameters under the impulsive control. We proved that two systems with a special oscillating parameters can get synchronized. The chaos-based secure communication system with high secure level can be designed based on this scheme.

articleTitle: Finding the locations of offenders in serial crimes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper focuses on developing different schemes and a technique to combine the results of them to generate a geographical profile of fixed serial crimes with a high reliability. The three different schemes based on physics, geometry and psychology of criminal. The combining technique considered the evidence, distribution of the crime scenes, the police force which was needed to search. This method gets a good result and easily to program. Finally, classifying the distribution of crime scenes and predicting the next crime scene can be studied in further research.

articleTitle: The research and design of the medical expert system based on the service soft bus architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: According to SOA and soft-bus idea, propose one new solution of the medical expert system design based on the service soft bus architecture. By studying the medical expert system integration, interface standardization, the system infinite expansion and global interoperability, the result of the researching have great significance in overcoming the local application of the system and the redefinition of the system architecture.

articleTitle: Study on service-oriented forth party logistics operation mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: To effectively integrate the logistics resources and improve the operation efficiency of the forth party logistics (4PL), this paper provides a service-oriented 4PL operation mode with the integration of modern service management theory, logistics management and service-oriented computing technology based on the analysis of the requirement of 4PL operation mode. On the basis, the operation process of service-oriented 4PL operation is deeply studied, which includes the process of logistics service encapsulation and publishing, outsourcing logistics tasks submission and planning, logistics services chain modeling and construction, and logistics services chain execution inspection and KPI evaluation. Finally, the enabling technology framework for service-oriented 4PL operation mode is established, which includes the technologies of 4PL operation technologies, logistics management technologies and information supporting technologies. The enabling technology framework provides the enabling technology supporting for the service-oriented 4PL operation.

articleTitle: Development of verbal-imagery cognitive style test
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This article introduced the main ideas of Riding's cognitive style research, interpreted the preliminary development of verbal-imagery dimension of cognitive style, discussed the further revision of the test and meanings of study on cognitive styles analysis.

articleTitle: An E-learning based graduation project support system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The problems in undergraduate graduation project of information management and information system major was analyzed, and according to the characteristics and problems, an E-learning based computer aided management method for graduation project was presented. The object-oriented method and unified modeling language (UML) was employed to design the use case model, object class model and software architecture for graduation project management. At last, an open and cooperative graduation project support system was developed and implemented on J2EE platform, and the E-learning method was realized in the undergraduate graduation project of the information management and information system major.

articleTitle: The building of harmony project management theoretical system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper sets up harmony project management system to build the common harmony of the engineering construction project's external environment and internal environment. The whole harmony project management theoretical system is divided into 4 parts. Each composing element is the support to the harmony project management system. They are not independent but inter-associated and interactive and meanwhile each element plays its role around the harmony project management culture.

articleTitle: Computer education for future science related teachers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Just as computer technology has improved effectiveness in numerous sectors of society, advanced computing and telecommunications have the potential to help students master complex 21st century skills. An Integrated curriculum is developing technologies that enable students use advanced tools to solve real world problems. The integrated curriculum approach improves success for all types of learners and may differentially enhance the performance of tomorrow's science teachers.

articleTitle: Distributed architecture for delivery simulators
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The numbers of high-risk pregnancies and premature births are increasing due to the steadily higher age of pregnancy. Medical simulators are used in training the doctors to deal with emergent perinatal situations. To enhance the training effect, sophisticated simulators are integrated into a realistic training environment that takes into account the medical instruments and team aspects. The training environment becomes increasingly complex and requires a clear structure for different training scenarios and flexible hardware configurations. Distributed multi-agent software architecture with peer to peer communication facilities is developed for this purpose. The architecture is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Applying computer multimedia to all teaching/learning links in the national excellent curriculum—Mineral processing plant design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Mineral processing plant design curriculum is innovated ceaselessly so as to improve the education quality and to bring students up the engineering diathesis and design competence through the courses, teaching material, experiment, practice in plants, and scientific research. The computer multimedia technic plays a important role in the curriculum innovating. In practice, a serial research, named APPLYING COMPUTER MULTIMEDIA TO A SET OF TEACHING LINKS is carried out. The computer multimedia is applied to compiling the teaching material, classroom teaching, classroom-work, practice after classroom, graduation project and second classroom, which have made great progress.

articleTitle: Development of embedded experiment platform on robot project-driven
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: For the present situation of out-of-joint between teaching and experiment in universities, this paper has designed and developed a embedded experiment platform on robot project-driven, which used modular programming on the base of robots in order to make the learners, according to practical project development, systemically learn the program of hardware, drives and applications and the transplant of operating system. The practice shows this platform has improved effectively the faults of the traditional embedded experiment platform which takes a single experiment and ignores project, system and unity designing, and provided the embedded courses with the new teaching and experiment method.

articleTitle: Incidence development strategy for internet in regional higher normal business education institutes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: State education institutes are believed as catalyst for the middle-education of any country. In china, many regional higher normal education institutes (RHEIs), such as regional university, be founded from 2000. Some graduate of those regional higher education institutes be the middle-school teacher. Those regional higher education institutes should improving their quality of teaching and learning for their graduate being good teacher. In this paper, we study analyses Internet - based teaching and learning issues at regional higher education (RHE) level and efforts to devise a strategy as solution to those issues as a result. Using normative Delphi method, we discussed internet -based issues and their proposed solutions but also stratified a incidence development strategy which chalks out measures RHE authorities should take in order to properly integrate internets in their RHEIs. It was determined that internet integration in RHE need to be in lined with proper strategy in order to get their true benefits.

articleTitle: DSP practice course teaching research of automation specialty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: DSP control and relative technologies have attracted the attention of multi-disciplines engineering researchers and educators, and are becoming a new and active field. This paper gives some discussions about teaching embedded systems in automation major, such as teaching target, course content, teaching methods and course examination. Through four years' practices, remarkable effects are obtained.

articleTitle: The effective improvement methods of university computer teaching result
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: University computer basis is a course combined with the quality of knowledge and technique ability. It is, however, harmful for learning because of the several existing problems about the traditional teaching mode and the methods of computer experiment. According to the problems above, especially computer experiment, we purpose some effective improvement methods that can extremely promote the interests and self-expressions of students, and the teaching result is good.

articleTitle: The Application of feedback learning platform in C++ course
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: As one type of learning platforms, feedback learning platform builds a way of mutual communication, information exchange and tracking study, including synchronous and asynchronous types of feedback. Under the traditional teaching patterns, C++ teaching method is constrained by the teachers' instruction as well as students' listening and practicing, which are traditional ways of feedback. However, feedback learning platform initiates a new approach for teaching and learning C++.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of course group network teaching platform based on knowledge points
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In most course group websites the contents of different courses are listed separately, so each course is independent from others. This can not reflect the characteristics of course group. In order to correlate the content of different courses, we propose the method based on knowledge points which are the basic teaching unit in course group. It will provide convenience for students to learn relevant contents. And students can understand and analyze one knowledge point from several different aspects. The system is mainly developed by using asp with database technology. At the knowledge points management AJAX technology is adopted.

articleTitle: ZPD incidence development strategy for internet in regional higher business education institutes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In china, many regional higher education institutes(RHEIs), such as regional university, be founded from 2000. articleTitle: Design of management system for membership supermarket based on B/S
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The issue elaborated the feasibility of system, the requirements of department, the mode of supermarket and the technology which is used by system according to department of software engineering principles. We designed the function of system according to the need of member ship supermarket, we made full use of information source not only to offer the qualified products, circumspect service, but also provided the humanize membership management.

articleTitle: An improved frame-slot ALOHA anti-collision algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In order to further improve identification efficiency of tag anti-collision algorithm in RFID system, we analyze the performance of the frame-slot ALOHA anti-collision algorithm, apply the idea of grouping in binary search algorithm to frame-slot ALOHA anti-collision algorithm, and on this basis, we propose an improved anti-collision algorithm to identify the collided tags in time slots quickly and correctly. The simulation results show that, the improved algorithm does improve the anti-collision performance, reduce the throughput of data, and improve the tag identification efficiency in RFID system.

articleTitle: Study on Chinese corporate governance structure of IT companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Inadequate corporate governance structure is a common problem of all listed companies at this stage, but also listed companies in China exist in one of the most serious problems. As China's “Silver Guangsha,” “Tin” and the incidence of events, financial fraud, to the capital market has brought huge losses, triggering people's corporate governance structure in depth. After years of academic research, people gradually found out the crux of corporate governance, and to explore the research related to management improvement measures, this article will begin in-depth discussion on this issue.

articleTitle: Fast rotation invariant face detection in color image using multi-classifier combination method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: A robust and real-time facial detector has been designed using multi-classifier combination method. The new detector composes of three classifiers: Skin color detector, AdaBoost detector based on haar-like features, and eye-mouth detector, a semi-serial architecture is designed to combine the three detectors, which set up the division and cooperation system and draw on each other's merits to implement the quick and efficient facial detection. An illumination independent skin color detector has been designed. Retinex algorithm based on the advanced adaptive smoothing filter is exploited to remove illuminant in color images and then skin color pixels are classified through there color information. This method increase efficiency and ability of skin color detection in images contaminated by illuminant. Besides this, the advanced adaptive smoothing algorithm adopts adaptive windows to replace the iteration, which guarantees real-time performance of skin color detector. Based on the acquirement and conditions of the new facial detector, a simple efficient eye-mouth classifier has been designed to reduce miss detection caused by rotary faces. The detector chooses color feature of eyes and mouth and geometric feature between eyes and mouth. Experimental result proves that the new face detector implements real-time face detection and improves detection robustness.

articleTitle: Application of blended learning model based on PCR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Blended learning is a method of educating which goal is to join the best features of face-to-face teaching with the best features of online learning to produce an optimal learning outcome. PCR (Program in Course Redesign) led by Dr. Carol A. Twigg in the United States has discovered five distinct blended learning models, three of them is supplemental, replacement and fully online. After blended learning and its three models are discussed here, the models are used in the course Computer Application Basis in higher education. Practical research shows improved quality of student learning, better student attitudes toward the subject matter, and increased instruction-used rates.

articleTitle: Application of virtual teaching platform of digital design and manufacturing in innovative teaching for numerical control technology specialty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: To promote students' learning interest and improve teaching effect, this paper establishes a virtual teaching platform of digital design and manufacturing for teaching reform of numerical control (NC) specialty. Based on analyzing the problems existing in current major teaching with traditional teaching method, the significance of adopting virtual teaching platform is illuminated firstly. Then the detailed examples, related to virtual design, engineering analysis, process simulation and virtual machining, are used to illustrate the specific application of the virtual teaching platform in innovative teaching for NC specialty courses. Teaching practice shows that, the virtual teaching platform is a powerful tool for teaching innovation, thus it is worth generalizing in teaching application.

articleTitle: Special Skill evaluation in Mechanical Operation Field based on fuzzy evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: A new evaluation method was proposed in order to improve the reliability of evaluation of special Skill in Mechanical Operation Field. It analyzed the relationship between the evaluation index and the operation skill, and built the fuzzy synthesis evaluation method according to the request and characteristic of the operation skill. Arrangement analysis method was used to determine weight of index for decreasing influence of subject factor. Fuzzy evaluation matrix was built based on fuzzy set transformation principle. Finally, a new fuzzy measure and evaluation system was designed.

articleTitle: Research on the network security of a web-based logistics information platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the development of enterprise information management technology and the improvement of computer-network technology, the application of logistics information system based on network becomes more and more extensive. On this condition, the need of security of web-based logistics infromation platform accordingly is higher than before. The paper firstly introduces the actuality and preventing measure of the network security briefly, then presents the establishment of this network security system based on the logistics information platform, which includes visit control, transmit control and server security control etc.

articleTitle: An E-Learning platform design based on tree structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: As one of the subject in modern educational technology, E-Learning has not been widely applied yet. The accumulation of knowledge is a tree growing process. From the person's cognitive processes, we propose a methodology for E-Learning design based on tree structure. Knowledge point is stored in a database as a record, and then is bound to a TreeView control, in order to show the form of a tree. Finally, a very visual and friendly user interface E-Learning platform with clear context between knowledge points was constructed by using the latest Microsoft development technologies. And the trial platform is supported by teachers and students praise.

articleTitle: The development of intelligent pressure transmitter based on HART Protocol
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: To solve the problem of the original investment hedge when the fieldbus control system (FCS) substitute the distributed control system (DCS), we design a low-power intelligent pressure transmitter which is compatible with analog signals and digital signals. The pressure transmitter is designed based on HART protocol and composed with MCU module, sensor module, HART communication module, LCD modules and power supply module. The digital signal will be converted into the digital audio signal through the V/I circuit in the design, superimposing on the current loop and realizing the compatible with digital signal and analog signal, at the same time, non-interfering. The total operating current of the entire circuit is no more than 2.1mA, guaranting the low-power requirement. By testing, the intelligent pressure transmitter can be connected with any manual control device or control system which are agreed with HART protocol, and the measurement accuracy has reached the requirement of 0.2%FS.

articleTitle: Design and development of mental health education system for university students based on B/S structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper established a mental health education system for university students based on B/S (Browser/Server) structure according to the theory of modern pedagogy and psychology. The system runs on the server-side which is developed by computer programming C# and SQL database. The client-side can be managed effectively, need only to have IE browser to log in the network. The system includes following modules, such as mental health education, psychological testing and evaluating, psychological consultation etc. It can reduce the burden on teachers, improve work efficiency and provide effective support for mental health education of university students because of clear flow, great practicability and easy to operate. It has certain practical significance to enrich and develop content and form of mental health education for university students.

articleTitle: Study on the causes of hypertension with improved BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: An improved neural network based on L-M (Levenberg-Marquard) algorithm neural network has been applied to the model for the analysis of factors on Hypertension. It can remedy the shortcoming of the slow convergence rate of traditional BP algorithm neural network. This model can determine which factors are the main reasons for high blood pressure. We have adopted the lattice fuzzy close-degree assessment and expert scoring method which quantified the various data of the factors on high blood pressure. We used the matlab to program and simulate. The results showed that: the improved BP neural network, can determine the main factors which causing the high blood pressure correctly, the error between the Predictive value and the actual value is very small. it reached the desired goal.

articleTitle: The impact on the development of sports enterprises making by the combination of E-commerce and networkmarketing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Nowadays with the rapid development of the information technology (IT), Internet is popular allover the world. More and more people look through the internet which provides tremendous business opportunities for the sports enterprises. At present E-commerce has gradually become the main business model at the information age. The development of the Internet and e-commerce applications provides a more efficient, more convenient operation model to sports enterprises. This paper analyzes the E-commerce is combined with network marketing which has a great influence on the sports enterprises and improves its efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on improving ecological compensation mechanism of mineral resources development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The defect of the ecological compensation mechanism in development of mineral resources is the origin of ecological damage and environmental pollution. Based on discussing the significance of improving the ecological compensation mechanism of mineral resources development, the shortcomings of the ecological compensation mechanism in current mineral resources development are analyzed systematically, and then countermeasures and proposals are proposed, including speeding up the legislative process, making the main object clearly, determining collecting channels, standards and methods of the compensation funds, improving impact assessment system of mining environment and establishing a special management department for ecological environment in mining areas, and so on.

articleTitle: Research on computer immune system with multilayer recovery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: There are many excellent characteristics in the nature immune system that can be cited in the computer immune system. Until now, some of them are being used in the safe of the computer great. But now in the computer immune system, the methods of the detection in some stage are singly. For this problem, a sort of computer immune system with multilayer recovery is designed here. It has three layers to protect the system and different detections are used in them according to different conditions and stages. All this work can improve the rate of detection and reduce the rate of the wrong catch.

articleTitle: The research of College Computer Basics teaching reform based on network education platform
