abstract: Based on the “1+4” Course System of “College Computer Basics” (CCB) and “the three-stage open-ended teaching model” in Anyang Normal University (AYNU), this paper introduces the support of network education platform (NEP) to this teaching model. To solve the common questions faced in the process of CCB teaching, it puts forward new ideas which are helpful to improve the teaching effects.

articleTitle: A web-based platform for inquiry learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Web-based inquiry learning refers to a learning activity,it constructs an interactive learning environment for student by utilizing the Internet and multimedia technologies, where student can choose and identify projects from school and social life, use a method similar with scientific research, acquire knowledge initiatively, applicate knowledge to solve problems, this activity is a strong supplement to traditional inquiry learning. This learning mode is conducive to cultivate students' innovation spirit and practical abilities, the platform is technical assurance to implement the web-based inquriy learning mode. According to the characteristics of web-based inquiry learning, in this paper we build a platform based on Web, and design its structure and function modules detailedly, discuss the Web-based learning methods, processes and results through an application case.

articleTitle: Analytical hierarchy process model applied to port logistics efficiency commentary
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper aims to construct analysis model of port logistics arrangement using Delphi and AHP method, furthermore, establishment of fuzzy analytical hierarchy process model and factor set. And calculate every index weight with the weighting method-G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> based on differential principle and appraise comprehensive efficiency using fuzzy theory and analytical hierarchy process evaluation method. Using the average weighting method make quantitative disposal with indexes of appraisal factors and educes port logistics comprehensive efficiency outcome. And in so doing,validating Dalian port logistics competitiveness actually which respects its efficiency status.

articleTitle: The innovation research and practice of computer specialized laboratory supervision and management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The university specialized computer laboratories undertake the computer experiment teaching, the extracurricular practice as well as the computer scholar research, the laboratory maintenance work is very frequent and also is arduous. How to make a comprehensive and effective laboratory supervision and management schema is an important practical problem. In this paper, combing with Microsoft's domain management schema with our custom windows service programs, we provide some research and practice innovation ideas. Practice has proved that our computer specialized laboratory supervision and management schemes reduce greatly manual operation maintenance, save hardware cost and achieve a high degree of automation management.

articleTitle: Sub-optimum evaluation on incomplete network information system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: An information system is classified into two classes, namely complete information system and incomplete information system. A unified description has been proposed through the concrete analysis of information systems. And based on the conclusion, a new method of decision making has been presented. The theoretical basis of the method is non-optimum analysis theory (NOAT), and thereby the NOAT is further perfect by introduced the concepts of middle-optimum degree and unknown-optimum degree. Then the entropy of information systems is defined. Meanwhile, the concept of influence degree has also introduced. Finally, it discusses about three decision making principles, namely maximum influence degree principle, minimum risk principle and maximum risk principle. An example is included to illustrate three decision making principles.

articleTitle: On courses construction and optimization of engineering majors in vocational and technical institutions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Engineering has the comprehensive, creative and practical essences, which combine technology with non-technology, science with non-science to be an organic whole. Consequently, it represents the integration of multi-subjects and multi-knowledge. Engineering courses are not just involved in a wide range of academic programs, but also have obvious cross-coupled features and prompt development. As a result, society requires more of the students in this major, in other words, we must attach great importance to the improvement of overall quality that we need to educate challenged talents with broad knowledge, innovative ideology, pluralistic ability to adapt to an era of knowledge economy. From the reality of vocational and technical institutions, this essay mainly explores the courses construction and optimization on its significances, effects, principles and matters we should concern to advance the quality of personnel education.

articleTitle: Statistical physics Gibbs ensemble theory application to Internet system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, we first give a brief review of statistical physics Gibbs ensemble theory, then present a detail analysis and discuss for its essence, characteristics, applicable conditions, applicable scope and application domain. We think that rapid developing Internet scale has reached or near the requirements of thermodynamic limitation and internet package Sockets have satisfied the basic requirements of Statistical physics. After analysis of its structure, composition and essence, we defined it as Socketon. Section 3 describes its behavior composition and gives out integrated mathematical expressions, and then we use the Gibbs ensemble theory into Internet system and deduced the partition function of Internet grand canonical ensemble. So produce a series of means, concepts and parameters to describe the Internet and the inner relations among websites and between website and clients. This opens a new research field.

articleTitle: A new method based on incomplete fuzzy preference relation for multi-objective decision-making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: A new fuzzy method for multi-objective decision-making is proposed, in order to resolve the incomplete fuzzy preference relation problems, and the specific algorithm is presented on the basis of the fuzzy consistent relation. To decrease the subjectivity in the process of decision-making, it is discussed how to do with the appropriate weights and how to optimize multi-objective sorting. It is concluded that it is feasible to apply the fuzzy consistent relation to multi-objective decision-making analysis, and the improved fuzzy method is workable.

articleTitle: The construction of a new MCU experiment platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: MCU has excellent high cost-effective, extremely wide application areas. Almost every piece of electronic and mechanical products in modern life is integrated MCU, it is one of the microprocessors that electronic technology industry workers often choose. For electronic and information technology major students, the MCU technology is an important professional skills, must be skillfully master. MCU experiment course is an important ways to master the professional skills. The current teaching methods and means of MCU experiment course have some shortcomings. Therefore this paper did a study and exploration, conducted MCU application system circuit for modular design, developed and produced circuit boards with a number of modules, rational and effective arranged experiment content, achieved good teaching results.

articleTitle: The feedback and adaptive control ability of the decision theoretic intelligent agent system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The decision-theoretic intelligent agent system has adaptive learning ability with feedback from the environment. The agent starts with a limited knowledge of the plant (environment), then it explores (samples) the plant to learn the plant's parameters. After it learns about the plant, it takes its actions accordingly. In this paper, we introduce the intelligent agent system; then we establish the feedback control; finally, we study the adaptive control.

articleTitle: Research of educational technology of computer networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, the problems in present computer networks education are analyzed. Then it is researched how to solve these problems. And the author gives some practical methods: using FLASH,VRML,Virtools, Form++ technology, designing effective simulation experiments, providing a CAI platform and combining practical applications in class.

articleTitle: Remote monitoring system of drug safety information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: As the common problem facing the world, drug safety has been one of the major responsibilities of the governments. Firstly, this article expatiates the necessity and feasibility of remote drug-monitoring, and analyzes the complexity of monitoring work by taking Suzhou as the example. On this basis, a new remote drug-monitoring system adapting to the local environment of Suzhou combined with GSP regulation is proposed. The article lays heavy stress on introducing the framework of system model and system conformation, and the advantages as well as the special features of this solution. In conclusion, the article also points out the direction of the “Suzhou Mode” remote drug-monitoring's future development.

articleTitle: The thinking of multimedia technology in Cognition Practice of civil engineering professional
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Cognition Practice in the training process of civil engineering professional talents has a very important role. This paper discusses the present problems in the practice process of civil engineering professional. The functions of multimedia technology and the basic principles followed in the practice process are expounded.

articleTitle: The application of multimedia technology in action-oriented instruction of volleyball course of sports majors in institutions of higher learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The application of multimedia technology in the action-oriented instruction of volleyball courses can improve the quality of volleyball teaching. By analyzing the application of specific technology in specific action-oriented teaching methods, a more reasonable teaching model for the course of volleyball can be developed. The multimedia technologies applied in volleyball teaching include CAI courseware making, motion video analysis, audio synthesis and animation data processing, which can stimulate students' interest and enhance teaching efficiency in their combination with the action-oriented instruction. The combination of multimedia technologies and the action-oriented instruction has a wide prospect of application in volleyball instruction, which is a highly practical course.

articleTitle: A polling MAC scheme for enhancing qos support in Bluetooth technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Bluetooth is an emerging technology for constructing Wireless Personal Area Networks (WPANs). In Bluetooth MAC protocol a classic polling scheme Round Robin(RR) for all master-slave connections. It is very challenging to provide QoS (Quality of Service) support in Bluetooth system. This paper suggest a new polling scheme to enhance QoS support for Bluetooth technology. The QoS classes are differentiated by two access policies in polling scheme. Exhaustive Service policy is used for higher priority slave including key or real-time data to access the channel and Gated Access Policy for other lower priority slaves. A mathematical model for the polling system based on imbedded Markov chain theory and the generation function was used to predict the mean information packet waiting time. The results of mathematical analysis and simulations show that the new scheme can guarantees better QoS and system stability in a simple way .

articleTitle: Exploration and research on the construction of course group of Signal and Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Course group is a new concept in higher education which emerges from the practical reforms in college course systems in recent years. In this paper, as teachers in charge of the core courses of Signal and Information Processing, we firstly point out and analyze the current problems existing in the process of teaching and learning of Signal and Information Processing courses, then propose the constructing ideas and implemental measures of how to establish the course group of Signal and Information Processing so as to cultivate students' innovative abilities and improve their comprehensive quality. We conclude that course group construction is very important to enhance educational reforms and still has a long way to go.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Evaluation of practice teaching modes based on information technology for electrical engineering curriculums
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on formation mechanism of enterprise IT outsourcing relationship
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In order to survive more and more enterprises have to put more attention to its core business and outsource its complex information technology. For many enterprises, what matters is no longer whether IT outsourcing should be practiced but how it should be well managed. Outsourcing Relationship is one of the key issues of IT outsourcing. This paper firstly reviews the literature about IT outsourcing relationships; secondly, it analyses dynamic mechanism of IT outsourcing relationship formation: external power including government, competitors, technology, suppliers' industrial level and internal power including enterprise's management ability, top management and outsourcing project; lastly, it forms one model and one analysis process to explain formation mechanism of enterprise IT outsourcing relationship.

articleTitle: Study on university social service evaluation method base on fuzzy mathematics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Social service is an important function of universities. A scientific evaluation method can promote the efficiency of social service. According to the questionnaire result, objective and principle of university social service, the evaluation indicator system on university social service was established, which is composed with the three primary indicators and seven secondary indicators. The university social service exist subjectivity. In order to ensure fair of the evaluation, the fuzzy mathematical theory was introduced. The evaluation method will convert qualitative indicators to quantitative indicators. An actual example of one certain university social service was evaluated and studied. The research shows that the university social service evaluation method is scientific and reasonable, which can provide powerful support to the university social service.

articleTitle: Remote engine room devices surveillance over 3G wireless net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The running status of various devices in engine room is very important factor for the safe running of devices in engine room or other application fields. In order to supervise the running status or performance of the many devices in engine room, an online remote devices monitoring system based on 3G network is proposed in this paper. The system could monitor the voltage, current and temperature of the various devices in engine room through the mobile surveillance terminal. The system sends the running parameter to the supervision center or mobile termination and receives the remote instructions from remote hand terminal or control centre by 3G or internet. The system could also set the alarm boundary of the voltage, current and temperature of the various devices, if the devices is running in abnormal status, the system would transfer the relevant information to the remote mobile terminal or the supervision center, as a result, the devices in engine room could be supervised or maintained with short time. The system shows the superiority in remote devices monitoring in practice.

articleTitle: Application of EWB in teaching of Digital Electronic Technology Foundation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: As a practice-oriented course, Digital Electronic Technology Foundation is an important professional basic course for the specialties of Communications, E-science and Automatic Control, etc. How to achieve seamless connection of theoretic study with practical teaching is an important problem that should be paid much attention to. In this paper, the EDA software is introduced into the theoretic teaching of Digital Electronic Technology Foundation curriculum, aiming to activate students' interests in learning this course and improve the teaching effect.

articleTitle: Design of the physical chemistry network teaching system based on Web
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the devepment of network and multimedia technology, the network and multimedia teaching have become a kind of teaching means with high-efficiency and good effects. The physical chemistry network teaching system adopting XHTML+ CSS+ASP+java-script+XML+ACCESS techniques has built a kind of Web platform based on data,which can satisfy the physics chemistry teaching course, remote learning, the teaching-studing interaction and so on. The pages were formed by DIV+CSS techniques to separate surface layer from structure layer. The system is composed of eight parts including school teaching system, experiment coach, tutorship answer, homework exercises, graduate garden plot, field development, remote teaching, hotspot links and six assistant parts. It is designed and presented using website with the text, picture, flash, video and so on. The system is characterized with easy use and management, extremely expansivity, stability, safety, high-efficiency and so on.

articleTitle: The comparative study of Chinese mainstream mobile learning software
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: As the rapid development of mobile technology and wireless networks, the application prospects of mobile learning is getting more and more broad. My work aimed at the current four major mobile learning software, Nokia's “Mobiledu”, Digidea's “Englishto”, Unbounded Learning's “Drop English”, “Learneasy” soft to make a comparative analysis of their interface design, technical support and content design. The analysis has found the similarities and differences of these three aspects, and summed up their respective strengths and weaknesses and the adaptation scope. It provides the basis for different learners select the appropriate mobile learning software, and also provides a reference for software developers [1].

articleTitle: Fuzzy synthetic evaluation of atmospheric environment quality based on entropy weight
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Considering the difficulties of calculation and the defects that the relationship among evaluation objects are ignored when using Fuzzy synthetic Evaluation Method to determine weights to the multi-factors, this paper put forward a new idea of determining weights to the Multi-objective evaluation factors useing information entropy. The differences of determining weights using Entropy method and the method of over standard with weight was compared in the weight calculation of evaluating indicators by using the fuzzy mathematics through using the atmosphere monitoring datas of 10 monitoring points in the city of Changchun. The results showed that when the evaluation involves a number of evaluation objects using this method was very convenient for fuzzy synthetic evaluation. Only one calculation was enough and it need not to calculate every monitoring point. This method predigested the fuzzy synthetic evaluation process greatly and the evaluation results were objective and reasonable.

articleTitle: Study of Organizational Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The learning organization describes an organization characterized by certain capabilities, the term organizational learning describes certain activities that occur at the individual, team, or organization level of analysis in all organizations. In this paper, we first introduce the capabilities leading to organizational learning: generation and generalization of knowledge; then study the role of levels in organizational learning; finally analyze Conditions Supporting Organizational Learning.

articleTitle: A comparison of the four evolutionary programming implementations used as function optimizers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this artical, four evolutionary programming algorithms (Standard EP, Meta-EP, Continuous Standard EP and Continuous Meta-EP algorithms) are applied to test to maximizing a solution against a highly multimodal test objective function. We will use the same population size to compare the effectiveness of these four algorithms according to their success rate, average number of function evaluation and average best fitness. We experiments with different population size.

articleTitle: Study of Feedback in Experiential Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The benefits of feedback in learning have been well documented. Studies across the past twenty years have brought to light three important findings. Individuals prefer specific, timely feedback. Timely and specific feedback enhances performance. Specific feedback that is provided throughout the learning task affects learner self-efficacy. In this paper, we introduce experiential learning; then we study Feedback in Experiential Learning; finally, we introduce self-efficacy.

articleTitle: The teaching research and practice of computer courses of arts in universities and colleges
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Aimed at the particularity of computer education of arts and with the purpose of training application-type talents for computer, this paper elaborates some experiences and ideas about teaching contents, methods and means in the practice of basic computer education of arts, including the author's practice and research of the teaching reform and its results.

articleTitle: Feature extraction and matching location algorithm based on wavelet moment and curvelet transform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In the process of wire bonding, pattern recognition system is often applied to measure the deviation of the actual chip relative to the sampling position (eye-point) in order to ensure the location accuracy and speed. In this paper, a new feature extraction and matching location algorithm based on wavelet moment and curvelet transform is proposed for wire bonding. The algorithm combines the good properties of wavelet moment and curvelet transform, in addition, the application of coarse and fine searching improves the matching efficiency and accuracy. Euclidean distance is chosen to finish the matching location of the eye-point images and images to be matched. Experimental results show that the algorithm has high performance in the positioning accuracy and detection efficiency. The proposed algorithm is also robust and suitable for automatic wire bonding vision positioning system.

articleTitle: Application research of 802.11-based wireless network in the library
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: At the present stage, most of the university library networks are using the wired networks. However, as the university staff's demanding for the Internet is increasing, the limited access terminals and the electronic reading rooms have been far from meeting the reader demand. Building a wireless network on the basis of the wired network can meet readers' demanding for Internet access and retrieval. This paper first analyzes the architecture of the library wireless network, and then by compare, selects the IEEE 802.11 standard to set up the wireless network; the paper focuses on the standards both 802.11b and 802.11g.

articleTitle: A scheme's synchronization of Chua chaotic system under the impulsive control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Most Chaotic synchronization control methods have some flaws which increase the security risks of the communication system. Attacker can reconstruct the chaotic system or estimate parameters by using the information of the chaotic system which can be obtained by analyzing the control signal. Therefore we propose a scheme's synchronization of Chua chaotic system with oscillating parameters under the impulsive control. In this paper, we proved that two systems can get synchronized without control signal transmitting.

articleTitle: Discussion on the method of basic computer education in characteristic university
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The situation and questions of basic computer education in characteristics university are discussed firstly. Then the reform and construction of university Computer-Based teaching are proposed. The paper has analyzed the different teaching approaches and addressed some teaching experiences for basic computer education.

articleTitle: Research on the ≪Auto-control theory≫ education innovation in the information age
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: ≪Auto-control theory≫ characterizes more teaching hours, involving much basic theories, heavy and complex concepts, high experiment requirement, rapid development and being full of difficulties. An education innovation has been proposed, including special academic report, the application of modern education means, the experiment innovation, the application of bilingual education and the examination innovation. The innovation promotes the learning enthusiasm of students, increases the efficiency of the education and strengthens capability analyzing, solving problems and bilingual application of the students. Practice has demonstrated that the innovation is applicable.

articleTitle: Practice on the teaching reform and curriculum building for the circuit analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: According to the course characteristics of circuit analysis, combined with the requirements of educational reform, this paper describes the teaching reform program and results for the teaching courses of circuit analysis of colleges and universities in building the team of teachers, improving the management institution, updating teaching ideas, strengthening the integration of content optimization, selection of teaching material, reforming the teaching methods and means, strengthening the practice areas, and so on. To promote curriculum development, to raise teaching standards and quality of education, to impel the development of educational technology provides a useful reference.

articleTitle: Research on regional agricultural structure optimization based on grey situation decision model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: From the point of view of changing the economic growth mode, under the guidance of system theory “The whole is greater than the sum of its parts”, this paper sets up a grey situation decision model. By analyzing the general effect measure, countermeasures affect measures and event effect measures of output, we find that the whole-scale agriculture structure of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region is reasonable. Parts of it need adjusting. Some beneficial conclusions were given in this paper.

articleTitle: An application of attribute recognition theory in land ecological security evaluation a case study on areas along the Changjiang River in Anhui Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Ecological security is the core and basis of sustainable land utilization. Study of land ecological security has become a forefront area in study of sustainable land utilization. Based on Pressure-State-Response model, the paper constructed an evaluation index system of land ecological security. The index system was composed of land resource pressure, land resource state and cultural environment response. Then the paper established an evaluation model of land ecological security based on attribute recognition theory. Finally the paper evaluated land ecosystem conditions of the nine cities along the Changjiang River in Anhui Province in 2007. The sequence of the cities is: Anqing<;;Chaohu<;;Chizhou<;;Chuzhou <;;Wuhu <;;Tongling<;;Maanshan<;;Hefei<;;Xuancheng. Maanshan, Hefei, Tongling and Xuancheng belong to “critically secure” grade and the other five cities belong to “relatively insecure” grade. Secure conditions of the three elements belong to “critically secure” or “relatively insecure” grade. The results can provide references for solution of land ecological problems.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design of “Player Killing mode” of Aerobics teaching for physical education major in higher school
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A semantic information retrieval system based on KIM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper studies the OntoText laboratory research project KIM Platform (Knowledge and Information Management Platform). Through the study, We found that the main KIM technical use of the current ontology and natural language processing areas are more highly regarded of the three open source projects, GATE, Sesame, and Lucene. In addition, this paper translated the KIM system into Chinese, and gave details of the physical search, physical model of search, pre-defined pattern search and keyword search implementation. At last, we analysed the problems of KIM system, and future direction of development.

articleTitle: Teaching application study of hybrid learning model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Take the “systems engineering” course as example, though the classroom learning, students understand the theory and method of systems engineering; Though the experiment courses, students implement the complicated algorithm of systematic engineering, and reach the experiment effect “Test -≫ Design -≫ implementation” by the experiment teaching aiding software which is developed by the student team; The opening course website offers asynchronous learning for students to achieve the opening learning. Teaching interaction area provides a communication platform for students. This opening interactive teaching promotes the learning initiative and exploration ability of students. This paper proposed the establishment of hybrid learning model which mixed with the classroom learning, experiment courses and opening-course website for students. In the “Classroom-experiment-network” hybrid learning model, not only the teacher can play the leading role as in the traditional classroom teaching model, but also the students can play the leading role as in the network studying model, and teaching and extracurricular activity combined each other. Teaching practice show that this model can improve the thinking and innovative ability of students.

articleTitle: A SAR images despeckling method based on adaptive bandelet thresholding
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In this paper, we have presented an adaptive bandelets based on Bayesshrink soft-thresholding despeckling method for polarimetric SAR images. Experimental results demonstrate that our algorithm has a good despeckling performance in polarimetric SAR images and typically preserves even the minor edges comparing with wavelet transform. Besides, the quantitative analysis of evaluation parameters is not difficult to find that the algorithm proposed in this paper is the optimal speckle reduction.

articleTitle: A new scheme for constructing training resources of design graphics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: A new scheme for training answers preparing and its teaching on design graphics is presented. In this method the answers are prepared firstly from 3D design, then these 3D models will be converted to 2D engineering graphics. 2D graphics will be further modified by 2D graphing software and the final answer will then be obtained. In which method the 2D answers and their 3D models could be obtained at the same time and will both be shown for help trainees understanding. The teaching efficiency is improved by proposed scheme.

articleTitle: On multi-agent based urban rail transport ridership forecast system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Ridership forecast is one of the important bases for urban rail transport network planning, design, construction and operation. For the shortcomings of traditional ridership forecast in the stiff human-computer interaction forms, the signal forecast model, the low computational efficiency and the intensive labor, multi-agent-based urban rail transport ridership forecast system was designed. The Man-Machine-Agent accepted the data from the users and allocated the forecast task to the Management-Agent, in the collaboration and coordination to the next Data-Evaluation-Agent, Model-Selection-Agent, Ridership-Forecast-Agent, returned the forecast results to the Man-Machine-Agent and gave the users the proposed forecast advice and guidance by the User-Proposed-Agent. The system have the excellence of playing a variety of forecast models for a variety of different conditions, and can satisfy the randomness, non-linear and non-deterministic case for the strong adaptability, robustness and flexibility.

articleTitle: Improvement of the mobile e-health wireless networks based on the IPv6 protocol
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The signals in the e-health support and curing system should be transferred in high quality, but in the traditional wireless network, the quality and the speed of the communications between the mobile e-health computers is slow. According to the three function entities of mobile IPv6 the protocol stack software is divided into several major modules, and proposed design and the division of sub-module based on the wireless networks which is consist of mobile e-health computers or mobile curing detection computers.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy AHM based on entropy weight in appraising forwarding agent of Third Party Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Forwarding agent of Third Party Logistics plays an important role in the enterprise supplies in the chain management. This article has established the choice indicator system of Forwarding agent of Third Party Logistics based on the qualification of forwarding agent, applying of Fuzzy AHM based on entropy weight on appraising forwarding agent of Third Party Logistics. Finally, the union concrete example carries on the empirical analysis.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of an online teaching system based on B/S structure and ASP technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Online teaching systems have become more popular in recent years by means of incorporating modern computer and telecommunication technologies into teaching/learning skills and objectives to facilitate students learning. In this paper, we describe the design method of an online teaching system by using B/S structure and ASP technology which are frequently used in web-based applications, and discuss how to program in ASP to implement the system in detail, especially the method of database access and picture storage in a typical online teaching system. Practices prove that our online teaching system works well with friendly interface and improved content.

articleTitle: Research and design of teaching case database of Science of Navy Command
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This article analysis the importance of Case Method in the teaching of Science of Naval Command, brings forward the necessity and significance of the building of Teaching Database of Science of Naval Command, and expatiates on design principles and structure of teaching case database of Science of Naval Command.

articleTitle: Application education about object-oriented hybrid symbol system of vector-raster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Symbol system is an important part of GIS system and CAD system. Analyzing the symbol systems of popular GIS systems and CAD systems, find out their merits and faults; and considering the requirement of geological field as mine and geological hazard, a vector-raster hybrid symbol system was designed. The paper introduced the main theory and key model of the symbol system, and introduced the advantages. And finally the fact is that the technology is feasible and could be widely used.

articleTitle: Model of bed arrangement based on Priority Sort
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper presents a model of bed arrangement that based on Priority Sort. The arrangement model is then used to adjust the part of the patient's hospital stay of the X hospital. And a model of comprehensive evaluation based on Fuzzy is used to evaluate the arrangement model and the original rule called “FCFS” (First Come First Serve) of the X hospital. Finally, an analysis is given by contrasting the results of comprehensive evaluation, that the arrangement model is much better than “FCFS” .And the model can be widely applied to other fields.

articleTitle: Based on wireless communication module NRF905 banking queuing system design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: This paper describes the wireless communication module NRF905 in the bank application of queuing systems. Describes the system's overall design, a brief introduction NRF905 module hardware features and software programming. Focuses on the realization of wireless communication methods and the development of communication protocols. Also introduced the system hardware design and workflow of each module. The system performed well in actuall use.

articleTitle: A new way of using multimedia screen to display dynamic production data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: That's very difficult for traditional display screen to achieve this function that is synchronous display of the industrial production data, because the traditional display screen can just displays static data and images. In this paper, we propose the multimedia dynamic display screen which can achieve the dynamic display of production data from various kinds of companies by this following way. At first, we can transmit digital data to PC through serial port (USB) which are transformed from simulated signals by start-board, after processing the digital signals; we can map those into display screen by using DVI interface decoder chip and the FPGA control chip. Finally, it is able to achieve a flexible dynamic display and remote monitoring.

articleTitle: On the wrong area of CAI in industrial design teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Some problems occur during the course of applying CAI technology in industrial design. This paper analysis the existing problems and explores the way to solve them. It is unavoidable to teach the industrial design class under the support of CAI technology. It should avoid applying the multimedia technology in wrong area and making use of the specialty of CAI to optimize the quality of teaching.

articleTitle: On establishing multi-dimension monitoring system for teaching quality of colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: It has been agreed that the establishment of self-improving and self-restraint monitoring system for college teaching quality will effectively enhance the teaching quality which is one of the aims of teaching evaluation. The system includes quality standard, information collection and statistic analysis and measurement, evaluation, information reaction, adjustment, etc. Monitoring teaching quality is not single and hidebound, but multi-level and diverse. On the basis of characteristics of higher education, this article proposes to establish a closed-up multi-dimension monitoring system for college teaching quality in an openly and active way.

articleTitle: The exploration and research of e-government profession teaching reform in higher vocational college
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the development of e-government, there is a serious lack of compound talents who both understand information technology and the government management, how to meet the market demands, how to lay a solid foundation for their future work is become a serious problem. In order to solve these problems, this paper first puts forward the necessity and urgency of teaching reform, then present the market needs and training target, on the basis of above, this paper researches e-government teaching reform, that is, employment-oriented, export decides import; build a clear idea of professional development; Competency-based, improve e-government education system; adopt modern teaching methods and means. Through the above teaching reform, we can improve the teaching quality and students' ability, and meet the market demand better.

articleTitle: A software skill self-training platform based on campus network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Practical training of software skill is important for software talents who urgently required by services outsourcing industry. We build a self-training system based on campus network which can provide services to those students or teachers to train themselves at the free time. The system is integrated on whSaaS together with TrustIE and an enterprise background. The portal shows resources integration schema, and we also give system topology and deployment. With the advantage resources in college and universities, students can achieve the leap from theory to practice at a low cost. The system can provide sustainable and cost-effective software training for local IT enterprises when opening.

articleTitle: State feedback control of networked control system with random delay
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The problems of system stability and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> /<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control are discussed by convert the uncertainty of time delays to the uncertainty of system parameters, and the design of state feedback is developed, which is a good solution of the problem of asymptotic stability of closed-loop system. A simulation example illustrate the validity of the design method presented above.

articleTitle: An algorithm for checking termination of Active XML documents materialization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Introducing Web services into XML documents, Active XML (AXML for short) brings more flexibility and dynamics, but also some new problems. Termination of materializing AXML documents is such a problem to XML documents and is undecidable in general case. This paper develope the termination problem of AXML documents materialization and propose algorithms running polynomial time to solve it under some restricts for AXML schema definitions. The main idea of our algorithm is to decide the termination problem by building corresponding AXML schema dependent graph and checking the acyclic of the graph. Finally, the correctness of the algorithm is also proved.

articleTitle: Discussion on teaching methods of innovative education for non-computer professions in engineering colleges
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Innovative education focuses on the goal of training students' innovative spirit and ability and therefore is an important teaching research subject in colleges and universities. In higher education institutions, traditional teaching, which attaches importance to theory and despises the training of students' all-around quality, ignores to train students' sense, ideation and ability for innovation. As a result, it does not fit to new demands for talents raised by the society. This paper discusses teaching methods of innovative education which centers on training innovative talents of non-computer professions in engineering colleges and further puts forward concrete measures and approaches to innovate teaching notions, teaching model and teaching method.

articleTitle: Two cases of learning Bayesian network from observable variables
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In terms of differences the structure of the network and the variables, the process of learning Bayesian networks takes different forms. The variables can be observable or hidden in all or some of the data points, and the structure of the network can be known or unknown. Consequently, there are four cases of learning Bayesian networks from data: known structure and observable variables, unknown structure and observable variables, known structure and unobservable variables and unknown structure and unobservable variables. In this paper, we focus on known structure and observable variables, unknown structure and observable variables.

articleTitle: Classroom bilingual teaching quality standards system based on Delphi method and AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Classroom bilingual teaching quality standards system is the most important content of bilingual teaching quality guarantee system. After stating the design principles, contents and design methods of classroom bilingual teaching quality standards system, an index system of classroom bilingual teaching quality standards system for student and inspectorate is developed by Delphi method based on the characteristic of classroom bilingual teaching. Moreover, the index weightings are decided by AHP in the paper. Furthermore, the proposed classroom bilingual teaching quality standards system has been applied in a certain university, and has achieved good effects.

articleTitle: An on-line teaching and learning system for electrical & electronic lab
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: There is much experience from years of on-line learning in electrical and electronics laboratory of Henan polytechnic university in the paper. Firstly we point out a series of serious problems in the way this yet-evolving means of learning. Problems include poor course-design and pedagogy; human limitations, both physical and cognitive, in learning effectively in non-linear hypermedia environments; the anonymity of learning, dictated by this technological means of communication; and the lack of tailor-made online resources, which fit the course objectives and the students. We suggest a system that combines the pedagogical, cognitive, and technological aspects of on-line learning, should be used when designing an online laboratory course. The paper presents the detailed frame of the system.

articleTitle: Design patterns application in a distributed system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: In the enterprise-level distributed application development, it is generally believed that the object-based message transfer should be the distribution of communications, therefore, designers of distributed object-oriented systems tend to be hierarchical design in order to reduce coupling between modules degrees and enhance the reusability of modules through the distribution of object behavior. However, the behavior of the dispersion between objects which communicate with each other will inevitably lead to higher complexity. This paper centers on the Observer and Mediator design patterns of strengths and weaknesses in the communications mechanisms to study these two kinds of design patterns in distributed applications and the complex role of communication between objects. At the same time, this paper is based on. Net Remoting distributed application system to verify.

articleTitle: Research and practice of experimental innovative modes in the control class
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Some problems of traditional experimental teaching in colleges are analyzed in this paper, then a three layers experimental system is put forward based on reforming and innovating the mode of talent training as fundamentality and development and reconstruction of new experimental equipment and experimental platform. In practice, focusing on the connection between knowledge, creating a new context, emphasizing the subject position of the student, training the operation ability and innovative ability are the guarantee of reform success.

articleTitle: Illumination removal in color images using Retinex method based on advanced adaptive smoothing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: An important challenge of any skin color based intelligent system is to filter off varying illuminant in color facial images. In this paper, we propose a novel Retinex algorithm which based on an advanced adaptive smoothing filter to remove illuminant in color images. The proposed method estimates illumination by convolving the input image with some adaptive smoothing mask windows, each mask weight in any window is computed via combining measures of the illumination discontinuity at each pixel. In this way, we can achieve an illumination estimation image of the original image which contaminated by illuminant. Then, Retinex theory is used to remove illumination estimation image from original image, and achieve the result image. This new algorithm is compared with available methods, and the comparative results indicate that the proposed method present more efficiency and promising result when images under harsh illumination conditions. In the end of this paper, the proposed method is evaluated based on natural condition color images by applying Bayesian skin color detector. The experimental results prove that the new method can increase accurate hit of skin color pixel detection and maintain real-time performance.

articleTitle: The influence factor research of information services supply in rural areas —based on factor analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The development of information service industry in rural area can effectively promote the rural economic growth, But there still exists many serious problems among the supply and the demand of information service in rural area. There have been some researches about the information service in rural areas. However, most existing researches are aimed at the demand of information service in rural areas rather than the supply. This paper mainly discusses the supply of information service in rural area, due to the consideration that the supply is very important for solving the problem of dislocation between supply and demand and accelerating information service market in rural areas. Author surveyed 115 Telecom value-added service enterprises in Chongqing, extract six factors from the sample of 115 questionnaire by groping factor analysis (CFA) , and test the reliability and validity for the questionnaire. Based on this analysis, author find out the primary reasons to restrain the enterprise providing information service in rural areas, and make some suggestions for government to formulate policies of promoting the supply of information service in rural areas.

articleTitle: Reform and practice on the course design of design of machinery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The present situation of the course design in design of machinery and the characteristics of personnel training and the reformational necessity were analyzed. Based on summarizing valuable experience of previous course design and reference successful measures of other universities, the standardized practice of topics, contents and scoring system of course design were put forward, aimed to enhance student innovation ability and practice ability. At the same time, the reform and practice of the course design of design of machinery were carried out. The result showed that the reform and practice can greatly enhance student's practice ability, innovation ability, and so on.

articleTitle: Research on the quality evaluation of college computer to classroom teaching based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the development of computer science and the quality requirement of the computer teaching in universities, high quality of teaching computer science evaluation, more showing its necessity and importance. Based on fuzzy mathematics theory as the foundation, detail the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of fuzzy mathematics, constructs the college computer to classroom teaching quality evaluation model, and the model is applied to the practical case, which provides scientific basis for recommendation.

articleTitle: National level characteristic major construction of Computer Science and Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Major of Computer Science & Technology (CST) in normal university should not only have the major's general features but also have its own characteristics. This paper discusses the major construction of CST in Anyang Normal University (AYNU) against the background of Ministry of Education of China's Characteristic Major Construction (CMC). From the aspects of major construction's training objective, training plan, assurance system and training effects, it introduces the preliminary effects of CMC in computer and information technology school of AYNU. Finally, it prospects the further work of CMC in AYNU.

Author Keywords: major of computer science and technology

articleTitle: A novel student-centered teaching reform on programming courses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Programming courses are regarded as for computer science major, good programming skill is key factor to the whole professional learning. We put forward some student-centered novel ideas of teaching reform on programming courses to effectively improve the ability of students via analyzing programming learning problems. Through four years practical teaching, it has been proven that the real student-centered teaching could improve students' ability and confidence.

articleTitle: A novel Office Word format examination educational software development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Microsoft Office Word is the most commonly used document writing software in Chinese college and university. At present, Office Word learning mainly depends on teacher's presentations, and student's learning effect is carried on by the form of paper-based test with choice type. This teaching and evaluation of the results are not very satisfactory. In this paper, a novel Office Word format examination educational software based on office automation technology is proposed. The software has a flexible framework which supports both desktop and web deployments, and which could check word format according to different requirements easily. Using the Word object model and Excel object model, the software could check a group of Word documents and export the check report as Excel. Practice has proved that the examination software could aid the students self learning.

articleTitle: Research on teaching method of WEB-based process management in engineering practice
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Engineering practice is an important part of the practice teaching in colleges and universities, which is an important way to enhance practice and innovative ability and develop creative talents. WEB-based engineering process management teaching model is an online method to plan, inspect, evaluate, feedback, control and regulate f the whole project, which makes teaching methods more flexible, teaching management more convenient, teaching evaluation more objective, and teaching effect more optimized.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese stakeholder governance structure of software companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Chief outsider control is in fact the case of property rights impersonal exercise of power were the principal agents of the system in order to give up control in exchange for a non-system control to control the agent's misconduct. This behavior is under the conditions of the planned economy, the traditional government-led corporate extension of the external governance structure. This is actually a state-owned enterprise corporate governance structure appears in the “principal problem” with the state-owned enterprise corporate governance structure, there were serious, “agency problem” together to form a corporate governance structure of corporate special “administrative intervention in the internal control ”phenomenon, greatly reduce the scale of corporate governance performance.

articleTitle: Research and design of open teaching and learning platform based on XML middleware
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: At present, there are many online teaching resources. However, they are independent. This paper analyzes the existing online education platform. Present integrating online teaching resources and establish an open remote teaching platform. It not only share online teaching resources but also integrates isolated heterogeneous data sources. This paper designs a XML-based integrated middleware three-layer system architecture. Give the key technology to solve the problem. Finally, introduce the main function of the system.

articleTitle: The philosophical thoughts of measurement information theory and its applications
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Information is also an objective reality like substance and energy. This paper first analysis the process of measurement using the information theory, puts forward the essence of measurement process and builds a information model for the measurement process, which can explain why the interference and error are always existed in the result of measurement. The dialectical relationship between the measurement process and the epistemology are also confirmed in this paper, in order to get the exactly information that can reflect the measured object, the paper put forward many methods following the epistemological principles. At last, The technology of multi-sensor fusion is used to reduce errors in measurement, which displays that the application of measurement information theory in science and technology. The measurement information theory is very important to guide the methods of design and ideas in measurement process.

articleTitle: Experiential Teaching based on Living Lab: A study on the telecommunication service experience
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: Since the 90s of last century, along with the domestic education reform process, the Western Experiential Teaching theory was introduced into China. The most difference between experiential teaching and traditional “spoon-feeding” teaching is that the former puts its emphasis on “learning by doing”, it concerns about the students' dominant position during the teaching process, focuses on two-way exchange of students and teachers, recognizes individual difference, and makes every student have their benefits. Living Lab model proposed by Massachusetts Institute of Technology of the United States in 1995 is a widely developed technology innovation model in recent years. Under this mode, the user is no longer the object of innovations, but transformed into the subject of innovations. This paper firstly defines the Living Lab and experiential teaching model, giving a review of their research and development, then experiential learning environment is constructed based on Living Lab, providing service experience simulated pilot project in the Living Lab through service-oriented architecture, to cultivate and train learners to grasp the interaction relationship between user-market-technology in the man-machine interactive environment. Finally we explore the ways of experiential teaching model innovation to enable learners to transform their roles from observers to thinkers then to practitioners, so as to promote students' self-development. This paper exemplifies in the telecom operation and management teaching, carries out experiential teaching model innovation practice, and it will have important significance and theoretical guidance value to our students learning styles and curriculum teaching patterns during the innovation and entrepreneurship education.

articleTitle: The security risk analysis of E-commerce and measure research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: With the recent emergence of business being conducted over the Internet, companies are inevitably using information technology to cut costs, increase productivity, reduce the time required to develop new products harness the collective expertise of their employees, and create an extended enterprise by forging closer relationships with their customers, suppliers, distributors and partners in order to remain competitive. There is a lot of risk behind the fast development of E-Business. It is significant to identify and control risks better for advancing the development of E-Business. This is necessary to classify and know about the risks of E-commence enterprises. The paper analyses the process of risk management to E-commence and give a multi-layer tactic framework of risk management.

articleTitle: Logistics courses network multimedia teaching method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: According to the characteristics of logistics professional courses teaching, the impact on the network multimedia technology is analyzed and the principles and objectives of network teaching reform of logistics specialized is proposed. Finally, the logistics professional network multimedia teaching method is constructed based on practice.

articleTitle: Gas productivity analysis of high speed non-Darcy flow in deformed media gas reservoir
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: The gas producivity is infuluenced by many factors. In the routine calculation of gas productivity, many factors were negelected for convenience such as the non-Darcy flow, the changes of gas PVT parameters and the deformation of rock media. In order to analysis the effect of these factors on gas productivity, the mathematical model of high speed non-Darcy unstable flow in deformed media gas reservoir, which takes the changes of PVT of real gas with pressure into consideration, has been made in this paper. Numerical difference technology is used to find solution to the mathematical model,in which there is a well in the center of the round closed layer and the well bottom hole pressure is kept as constant in the production. And the effect of the factors on the gas productivity is analyzed. The results show that the influences of porosity changes caused by media deformation to productivity can be neglected, the changes of permeability can lead to the decreasing of productivity in the early period. And the productivity under the conditions of the high-speed non-Darcy flow and the changes of gas PVT is higher than the one when the gas flow is linear and PVT of gas is constant. These research results are meaningful to predict the gas productivity accurately.

articleTitle: Establish an effective formative assessment index system of College English learning based on the online learning software
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: According to the evaluation demands of College English Curriculum Requirements, this paper analyzes the advantages of formative assessment in college English learning, demonstrates the relationships among the online learning activities, capacities, and evaluation conclusions. Combining the formative assessment theory and practice with fuzzy mathematics, this paper establishes an effective formative assessment index system of college English learning and several formulas to check students' capacity change especially under the innovative teaching model based on the computer and online learning.

articleTitle: Developing the evaluating metrics of mobile multicast
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Health Networking Digital Ecosystems and Technologies (EDT)
abstract: To further advance the popular deployment of the mobile multicast, there are still many obstacles needing to conquer. One significant issue is to provide the quantitative evaluation of the mobile multicast to convenience the pricing and feedback control of the system, and moreover, to convenience the estimation of the mobile multicast protocol and the improvement of the more practical and optimal algorithm. This paper proposes a rudimentary two-aspect structure of the mobile multicast evaluation metrics, one is the measure standard of estimating the mobile multicast environment, the other is the measure standard of evaluating the mobile multicast protocols. Following the concepts, we also give out computational formula of the key factors of the two metrics. These will make a fundamental basis on quantifiable measurement of mobile multicast.
